packages.name: smwblocks-launch-pad
packages.title: Launch Pad
packages.description: This launches Mario if he hits it while running. Makes him fly forward for about 5 screens.

packages.name: smwblocks-ledge-hurt-blocks-v1
packages.title: Ledge hurt blocks v1.01
packages.description:
This hurt block does not hurt Mario when jumping or swimming upwards, allowing them to be used as ledge tiles.

Update v1.01:

-Fixed a bug regarding corner interaction.
-Added the option to make the block kill the player instead of only hurting him.
-Added SA-1 tag.

packages.name: smwblocks-ledge-vine
packages.title: Ledge Vine
packages.description: This block acts like a ledge if the player is standing on top of the block, but pressing down makes it act like a vine. Unlike 'Vinecloud', this one sets a value in RAM address $8B that allows the climbing flag to be set so that the player doesn't just fall if not pressing down. When climbing up from a vine below it, the player will pop up into the air and land on the top of the ledge.

packages.name: smwblocks-left-and-right-conveyor-blocks
packages.title: Left and Right Conveyor Blocks
packages.description: There are 2 conveyor belt blocks in the ZIP. The speed of them is adjustable.

packages.name: smwblocks-left-right-only-block
packages.title: Left & Right Only Block
packages.description:
Included in this ZIP file are:
- Left Only
- Right Only
- Left Only On
- Left Only Off
- Right Only On
- Right Only Off
- Left On, Right Off
- Left Off, Right On

packages.name: smwblocks-level-ender
packages.title: Level Ender +10 Coins
packages.description:
I noticed the various "fancy" level end blocks on the site - so this one is simple.

When touched by the player, the level end walk begins, keeping the current level music > adds 10 coins to the counter (can be changed @ !Coins) > and then shatters - End of!

packages.name: smwblocks-life-stealer
packages.title: Life Stealer
packages.description: This block will steal a life from the player if he has more than one and then shatter. If he only has one, the block will simply kill him.

packages.name: smwblocks-limited-jump-on-off
packages.title: Limited Jump On/Off
packages.description:
Blocks that will disappear after you jump off them for x times. They also switch the On/Off state for each jump. Graphics for the blocks from 1 to 4 are provided.
The order of the blocks is important because each blocks changes to the next block in Map16 after triggered.
These blocks are inspired by the limited Number blocks from the Flux Baserom.

credits would be nice but are optional

packages.name: smwblocks-limited-spawner
packages.title: Limited spawner
packages.description:
This unique block, when hit by a player or sprite, spawns a custom or normal sprite. Unlike easy-to-make versions (by blockreator or "%call_routines()"), this block will not spawn sprites if at least one of them is true:

-if all slots are full (12/12 for smw, 22/22 for sa-1)
-if the number of sprites that the block spawns is higher than or equal to the customizable limit

This is useful for puzzle levels if you don't want the possibility of getting stuck and being able to spam sprites to fill up all the slots and cheat the level and having slowdowns because of it.

Moderation Comment: With this block is very easy have problems with oam. Please use NMSTL patch if you use this block. Also don't use in zones with a lot of sprites.

packages.name: smwblocks-lm-1
packages.title: LM 1.7+ Trigger Blocks
packages.description:
These blocks activate and deactivate the ASM triggers (custom and one shot) in Lunar Magic v1.70+'s ExAnimation settings.
Includes blocks working like ON/OFF switch, P-Switch, and simply by touching. Also included are blocks that are solid depending on those triggers.

"Acts like" settings are specified within the asm files. Except for the "solid if" blocks (which need 25), just make them act as you see fit.

packages.name: smwblocks-mario-interactable-1f0
packages.title: Mario Interactable 1F0
packages.description:
Mario got tired of seeing the sprites having fun in 1F0's and now he wants to join the party!
What if Mario would be able to interact with them?
This is the official release of a block posted on 2023 C3.
Use as 1F0 to interact with other sprites or 25 to Mario-only.

This includes an L/R reset(death) in case players get stuck.

packages.name: smwblocks-mario-only-and-sprite-only-blocks
packages.title: Mario-Only and Sprite-Only Blocks
packages.description:
The classic blocks that are only solid for Mario or sprites which makes a lot of new setups possible.
This version allows you to make multiple different blocks like ledges and slopes only solid for either just by using 1 asm file.
It also contains settings for whether blocks solid for Mario should also be solid for his fireballs and/or Yoshi and vice versa.

versions.title: Mario-Only and Sprite-Only Blocks
versions.filename: mario solid and sprite solid blocks.zip

packages.name: smwblocks-mario-vs-dk-switches-and-blocks
packages.title: Mario vs. DK Switches and Blocks
packages.description:
This block pack is inspired by SMWCP's level named "Switch of Many Hues". When Mario presses a colored switch, the corresponding colored blocks will become solid while all other colors will be deactivated (so only 1 color switch is always activated, like radio buttons). Very useful for designing puzzle levels.

I made this using the manual trigger of LM.
Read the readme to setup the blocks correctly.

1/31/2016 edit: Added palmask.

versions.title: Mario vs. DK Switches and Blocks

packages.name: smwblocks-memory-based-conditional-map16-blocks-key-locks
packages.title: Memory-Based Conditional Map16 Blocks (Key Locks)
packages.description:
These blocks pack contains blocks that when triggered, will not respawn when the player leaves and returns to the level. Unlike using LM's conditional map 16 alone, this allows you to have up to 128 flags per level, and the absolute limit of a total of 2048 for the entire game. Blocks included:

-Key blocks
-Locked gates (solid barrier that disappear when unlocked). These include 16x16, 16x32, 16x48, 32x16 , 48x16, and 32x32 -block gates
-Locked doors (Credit goes to MarioFanGamer for his door blocks). These include a normal and small.

This is good for exploration-base hacks that involve backtracking.

packages.name: smwblocks-message-block
packages.title: Message Block
packages.description: When you touch this block, it will display a level message and disappear.

packages.name: smwblocks-midway-block-with
packages.title: Midway Block with 50-Coin Teleport
packages.description: This block will set the midway point if hit from below, but if the player hits it with 50 or more coins, it'll also teleport him to the screen exit set in Lunar Magic. Think of it like the Star Posts from Sonic 2.

packages.name: smwblocks-midway-point-blocks
packages.title: Midway Point Blocks
packages.description: Contains two blocks that act as a midway point. One acts like a somewhat regular one, generating a sound and setting the midway flag. This one can only be activated from below (though you could move the labels around to change that). The other one should be used as an invisible midway point blocks - it doesn't give off any indication that you reached the midway point, but it does set the flag.

packages.name: smwblocks-mine-blocks
packages.title: Mine Blocks
packages.description: These blocks blow up like Bob-Ombs or burst into flames (like lightning) when touched by the player.

packages.name: smwblocks-momentum-based-conveyor-belts-and-wind-v1-1
packages.title: Momentum-based Conveyor Belts And Wind v1.1.1
packages.description:
Unlike all other conveyor belts/wind on the blocks section (that increment or decrement $94 and $96), these new ones are more closer to the real-life physics using momentum. For example When you get off the conveyor belt, you will have the speed from the conveyor belt added to the player's speed.

v1.1.1 update:
-Fixed the wind block not working when having !Freeram_NewSpd set to use a word-sized RAM ($xxxx)

v1.1 update
-Moved from uberasm patch to uberasm tool (this resource first came out before the tool was created)
-Fully supports SA-1

versions.title: Momentum-based Conveyor Belts And Wind v1.1.1

packages.name: smwblocks-more-timed-button-switches-2
packages.title: More timed button switches 2.0
packages.description:
This package contains new timed switches based on the p-switch. Allowing you to design puzzle level with more than 2 switches and not affecting your sprites, used blocks and coins.

Sorry, no p-switch music.

packages.name: smwblocks-multiple-coins-block
packages.title: Multiple Coins Block
packages.description: This coin will give to the player a customizable amount of coins (SA-1 compatible) (Major Flare: now the amount is customizable).

packages.name: smwblocks-music-volume-changer
packages.title: Music Volume Changer
packages.description:
A block that, when interacted with, will allow the player to increase the background music's volume by pressing up, or decrease it by pressing down.

AddmusicK is needed to insert two included sound effects. This block will not work without them!
See the included readme for more details.

packages.name: smwblocks-music-volume-fader
packages.title: Music Volume Fader
packages.description:
A block that, when touched by the player, will fade the background music's volume to a new value and then destroy itself.

AddmusicK is needed to insert the included sound effect. This block will not work without it!
See the included readme for more details.

packages.name: smwblocks-net-tile-disappear
packages.title: Net Tile Disappear
packages.description:
This tile acts just like the regular climbing net tile, however it will turn into a puff of smoke and disappear once Mario punches it.

Works if Mario is in front or behind the climbing net tile.

Special thanks to yoshifanatic for some coding assistance.

packages.name: smwblocks-next-map16-key-block-v1
packages.title: Next Map16 Key Block v1.3
packages.description:
This block will change into the next Map16 block after you touch it with the key. The key disappears in a puff of smoke. You can adjust the sound effect too. Credits not needed.

Version 1.3 fixes the position of the smoke puff on block change and significantly optimizes the code overall.

packages.name: smwblocks-no-carry-yoshi-pipe-caps
packages.title: No Carry/Yoshi Pipe Caps
packages.description:
Ever worried that players can glitch sprites through pipes? Worry no more! These pipe caps, unlike SMW's, won't let the player carry sprites or Yoshi to another level, making it impossible to have glitched sprites in the next level, similar to the pipes in NSMB.

Now you can have buzzy beetles, bob-ombs and other sprites with absolutely no problems. It also fixes problems with custom sprites as well.

This version now checks $7E:148F, so there are no exceptions.

packages.name: smwblocks-no-carrying-pass-v1
packages.title: No Carrying Pass v1.1
packages.description:
This block will not let you pass if you are holding anything.
(done on MetaKnight's request)

Knight of Time update: Made the block SA-1 compatible and added a gif of the block in action.

packages.name: smwblocks-no-horizontal-movement-blocks
packages.title: No Horizontal Movement Blocks
packages.description: Two blocks that keep Mario from moving to the left or right. Also keeps him from jumping. Useful on the tops (or bottoms) of levels to keep Mario from running across.

packages.name: smwblocks-no-item-blocks
packages.title: No Item Blocks

packages.name: smwblocks-no-item-box
packages.title: No Item Box
packages.description: This erases the item in your item box, optionally playing a sound or disappearing.

packages.name: smwblocks-no-jump-block
packages.title: No Jump Block
packages.description: This block disables Mario's jump and/or spinjump when Mario is touching it from above. It's pretty customisable, as it can be configured to only restrict Mario's jump on certain conditions (on/off switch, blue/silver p-switch and Mario is in water/starman/on Yoshi). Check the asm file for those customization options.

packages.name: smwblocks-no-yoshi
packages.title: No Yoshi V2
packages.description:
New: This is a small update that should fix the glitch where Yoshi doesn't always disappear in a puff of smoke and makes it so baby Yoshi can't pass this block either.
Old: A block that if riding Yoshi forces the A button to be pressed forcing Mario off of Yoshi, Yoshi then dies in a puff of smoke and plays a sound. Sound is easily changeable.

Tester's note: It still doesn't always kill the Yoshi. Try entering the block from the bottom.

packages.name: smwblocks-no-yoshi-intro-block
packages.title: No-Yoshi Intro Block
packages.description: This block enables the no-Yoshi/ghost house/castle intro upon touching it. Important conditions are inside the .asm file. Thanks to Zeldara109 for the original code and Yoshifanatic for info related to the 'mounting off Yoshi' animation! Requires this UberASM if you wanna filter Yoshi at the checkpoint.

packages.name: smwblocks-normal-conveyor-slopes
packages.title: Normal Conveyor Slopes
packages.description: These "normal" slopes will move Mario like if they were a conveyor. Includes an example list to show how to use; you have to set the acts like to both the two slope tiles and the so called "slope assist" tile. (eg. the corner)

packages.name: smwblocks-note-blocks
packages.title: Note Blocks
packages.description: A near identical replica of SMW's note blocks. Can be set up to be bounced on the sides but can't be used to spawn an item. Included with it is a variation which shatters either on use or at least when bounced on (requested by SJandCharlieTheCat).

packages.name: smwblocks-object-powerup-blocks-v1
packages.title: Object Powerup Blocks v1.1
packages.description:
These blocks mimic the super mushroom, flower, feather, 1-up, and star sprites in SMW. Useful if your hack somehow has a lot of sprites but needs the powerup sprites.

v1.1 (Zuccha):
- Added star and 1-up blocks

packages.name: smwblocks-on-off-block
packages.title: On/Off Block
packages.description: A customisable on/off block which unlike most imitators is able to actually display a bounce animation (which for this reason requires PIXI v1.40 or newer) but can be disabled for your likings as well as be set to be one-way only, change to a different block (thus being single-use) as well as be triggered by a whole lot of options (kicked objects, spin jump and fireball besides the usual cape).

packages.name: smwblocks-on-off-conveyor-blocks
packages.title: ON/OFF Conveyor Blocks
packages.description:
A block that moves Mario to the right when the ON/OFF Switch is ON, and vice versa.

Some credit to ninja boy for helping me through this.

Demonstration: Click.

packages.name: smwblocks-on-off-frozen-lava
packages.title: ON/OFF Frozen Lava
packages.description: These blocks act like lava when the ON/OFF switch is ON and resemble frozen lava -which makes them also slippery- when the ON/OFF setting is OFF.

packages.name: smwblocks-on-off-pressable-button-switch
packages.title: ON/OFF pressable button switch
packages.description:
These 4 blocks are pressable button switches similar to the on/off switch.
Unlike the SMW vanilla on/off switch where you have to "bump" the switch, you instead have to "press" the switch to activate it (like a p-switch).

packages.name: smwblocks-on-off-shatter-blocks
packages.title: ON/OFF Shatter Blocks
packages.description:
This pack contains 4 blocks.
The first one will shatter if the ON/OFF switch is on, the second one will shatter if the ON/OFF switch off, the third one will shatter and let bounce the player if the switch is on, the fourth one will shatter if the switch is off.

packages.name: smwblocks-on-off-spike-block
packages.title: ON/OFF Spike Block
packages.description:
This block has either a spiky top or bottom, depending in which state the "ON/OFF switch" is.
It can be reversed,too. Now, when it's "ON", the top is spiky and the bottom is flat. When it's "OFF", the opposite applies.
Check the block for reversing the effect.

packages.name: smwblocks-on-off-switch-door
packages.title: On/Off Switch Door
packages.description:
A door that either sets the On/Off switch to On or Off depending on which block you use.

fixed the error with no Return label found

Requested by Kaizoman666

packages.name: smwblocks-on-off-switches-single-hit-and-state-changing
packages.title: ON/OFF Switches (Single Hit and State Changing)
packages.description:
These ON/OFF switches become solid once hit and switches again when the other state switch is hit! Features include interactions with:
>Mario fireballs!
>Thwomps!
>Cape!
>also gets rid of double hits entirely!!
Check the asm files for disabling interactions with thwomp and fireballs!!!

versions.title: ON/OFF Switches (Single Hit and State Changing)

packages.name: smwblocks-one-life-left-block
packages.title: One Life Left Block
packages.description: This block will leave you with one life if you touch it. If you already have one life when you touch it, nothing will happen.

packages.name: smwblocks-one-shot-fire-flower-block
packages.title: One-Shot Fire Flower Block
packages.description:
This is a block that when collected, will award Fire Power that can be used for a single shot. Collecting multiple blocks will give the player the respective amount of shots. When the player's shots have been used up, they will revert to big Mario.

See the asm file for some customization options. Requires a few small helper patches (inserted with the block) to handle the fireball counter.

Requested by KatMakes.

packages.name: smwblocks-one-tile-vertical-pipes
packages.title: One Tile Vertical Pipes
packages.description:
These blocks act similar to traditional vertical pipe blocks except it no longer checks for your position making it much easier to enter the pipe, this is also very useful for if you want to have pipes that are shorter or longer than 2 tiles wide. (like the jars from Super Mario Bros. 2)

Version 1.1 Changes:
- Added SA-1 compatibility
- Merged the two blocks from 1.0 into 1 file.
- Changed FreeRAM address to avoid conflict with other patches.

packages.name: smwblocks-one-use-note-blocks
packages.title: One-use Note Blocks
packages.description: This note block can only be used one time before breaking.

packages.name: smwblocks-one-way-blocks-1-3
packages.title: One-Way Blocks 1.3.1
packages.description:
Unlike the ropes, these blocks has major improvements:

-one-way down blocks don't make mario descend extremly fast, it only solids if mario's Y speed is upwards

-one-way side blocks don't block mario if he's directly inside them going in the opposite direction

-It applies also to fireballs

packages.name: smwblocks-ow-warper
packages.title: OW Warper V3
packages.description: When you touch this block, it will warp you to a different OW/submap. This is a better version of my old block, I didn't know how to work with 16bit address then. I also explain how to get Mario to a specific point in the OW in the asm file.

packages.name: smwblocks-p-balloon-interactable-blocks
packages.title: P-balloon Interactable Blocks
packages.description:
These 4 blocks are useful for puzzle/balloon levels that interact with the player differently, these include:

-a reuseable solid block that makes mario balloon if he's hitting the bottom or spinjumping the top.*
-an "anti-balloon" block that takes away mario's balloon.
-a block that is solid when mario isn't balloon mode.
-a block that is solid when mario is balloon mode. (balloon timer won't expire when mario is inside, to prevent dying inside/falling inside the now-solid block).

*Note that it actually spawns the sprite on the player, rather than setting the timer and flags, (due to the fact that mario has no controls when doing that). You can use any SP4 and glitch graphics still aren't visible (you see some pixels around mario but not a major problem).

you might need Balloon direction fix
so mario can face left/right (unlike the P-balloon/Cloud Fix which mario can still go faster holding left+right (but not through walls))

NOTE2: balloon mario is immune to damage if he is inside balloon_passable.asm so he can't die instantly afterwards (even though he isn't small), I also use a check so it doesn't lower his flashing invulnerabilty timer (when if he takes damage, gets the balloon, then touches the balloon pass block while prior flashing, wouldn't set it to 1 (being the minimum value the block allows), thats why there is a branch)

Tester's Note: There's like a 1/100 chance you don't collect the P-balloon after it spawns when hitting the corner in some weird way. Can't really reproduce it with certainty. Maybe you want to set SP4 after all.

packages.name: smwblocks-p-block-v1
packages.title: P-Block v1.0
packages.description:
This simple block will behave like a Blue or Silver P-Switch, depending on whether it will turn brown "used" blocks into coins (and vice versa), or it will turn some sprites and munchers into coins as well.

Feel free to customize the block in the ASM file.

packages.name: smwblocks-p-switch-set-on-powerup
packages.title: P-Switch Set on Powerup
packages.description: This block will act like a blue P-Switch has been pressed when touched. The difference, however, is that the time it lasts depends on your powerup. The length of time and other things can be edited in the ASM file.

packages.name: smwblocks-p-switch-set-reset
packages.title: P-Switch Set/Reset
packages.description: Four blocks that either set or reset the blue or silver P-Switch. Also changes music accordingly.

packages.name: smwblocks-p-switch-star-blocks
packages.title: P-Switch Star Blocks
packages.description: These blocks will reduce the P-Switch switch timer to 0, and convert any P-Switch time you had and make it star time. Comes in blue and silver versions.

packages.name: smwblocks-p-switches
packages.title: P-Switches
packages.description: A set of ungrabbable P-Switches which can be either blue or silver, rightside up or upside down, solid to sprites or not, can be jumped on or not and changes to the next Map16 tiles.

packages.name: smwblocks-paper-mario-save-block
packages.title: Paper Mario Save Block
packages.description:
This block, similar to Paper Mario, will save the game, make sound and display customized text when hit from the bottom. It can only be used once when in a level, then you have to re-enter the level to use it again. Text-free version and VWF Dialogues compatible versions included.
My first custom block :D

packages.name: smwblocks-pass-if
packages.title: Pass If 5+ Lives
packages.description:
This block lets you pass if you have 5 lives or more.



Fermin Acosta Jr.'s Update 7/16/2020: I added another SA-1 hybrid compatible

packages.name: smwblocks-pass-if-carrying
packages.title: Pass if Carrying
packages.description:
A simple block that makes it so that the player can only pass through if he/she is holding an item.

Requested by mapsking.

Tester's note: Side-effect: If the player drops the item while being right inside the block, the player will die. Other than that little quirk, nice block.

packages.name: smwblocks-pass-if-no-sprites-on-screen
packages.title: Pass if no Sprites on Screen
packages.description: This block will let you pass if there are no sprites on the screen. More details in the readme.

versions.title: Pass if no Sprites on Screen

packages.name: smwblocks-pass-on
packages.title: Pass On 99 Bonus Stars
packages.description: This block lets you pass if you have 99 bonus stars.

packages.name: smwblocks-pass-through-ledge-by-pressing-a
packages.title: Pass-Through Ledge by Pressing A
packages.description:
Unlike other passable ledges, this one requires the player to hold down and tap A to fall through. This is useful if you want the player to have freedom to duck and duck-jump without having to fall through.

However, if the player is riding Yoshi, it requires only to tap down to fall through.

packages.name: smwblocks-passable-by-shells
packages.title: Passable By Shells
packages.description: A block that is only passable by shells.

packages.name: smwblocks-passable-ledge-with-sfx
packages.title: Passable Ledge with SFX
packages.description: A ledge that can be passed through by tapping down.

packages.name: smwblocks-passable-on-a-b-button
packages.title: Passable On A/B Button
packages.description: Two blocks. One makes the player pass from whatever side as long as A or B is pressed (blck1.asm), the other (blck2.asm) makes the player pass when neither of those two buttons are pressed.

packages.name: smwblocks-passable-on-all
packages.title: Passable On All (5) Dragon (Yoshi) Coins
packages.description: This adapts the block "Passable On Yoshi Coins" to make it function properly when all coins have been collected (with that block, if you die after collecting the coins, the coins will not respawn and there will be no way to make the custom block passable without resetting the game). This does not replace the other block; I have submitted this as I keep seeing the other block used wrongly and it pisses me off. An analogous version of this block could be found in the old blocktool of jonwil.

packages.name: smwblocks-passable-on-yoshi-coins
packages.title: Passable On Yoshi Coins
packages.description: A block that lets you pass when you have 4 Yoshi Coins. (Exact amount easy to specify in the .asm file.)

packages.name: smwblocks-passcode-blocks
packages.title: Passcode blocks
packages.description:
Unlike everybody else, this passcode depends on lunar magic exanimation's manuel trigger to show to the player the inputted passcode. It contains 4 number blocks, 4 up/down controller blocks, and a door. See readme for details.

NEW FEATURE: A randomized password. Great for those don't want their password to be shared by other players (let's play and walkthrough). This requires uberasm though and the "Better Random Number Generator" (not mandatory, but highly recommended) patch.

packages.name: smwblocks-password-blocks-alternate
packages.title: Password Blocks (Alternate version)
packages.description:
Place the 7 blocks in any order you wish, but they are designed in such a way as to have one combination and only one. They must always be hit in order, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. If you want to lay them out in a straight row in the order 4, 6, 3, 1, 7, 5, 2, they'll work the same way. These blocks may be set to act like whatever you wish.

Doors (door_block.asm) are activated if the correct code is put in.

See readme for full explanation.

packages.name: smwblocks-pay
packages.title: Pay 5 Coins/Lives to Pass
packages.description:
This file contains two blocks. One requires the player to pay 5 lives (quite a toll) before being able to pass, the other requires the player to pay 5 coins. Amount can be adjusted easily. Requires one byte of free RAM per block.


Fermin's Update 7/15/2020: I added SA-1 hybrid code. So is my first time that I made sa-1 comaptible.

packages.name: smwblocks-pay-exchange-block
packages.title: Pay/Exchange Block
packages.description:
This block is the exact opposite of the shop block. Instead of taking coins and giving you an item, it takes your item box contents and gives you coins. The coin amounts that are given can be customized. The block also plays a sound effect upon being hit.
Warning, you will need to modify the table that the block uses if you can have anything non-normal (shells, keys, vines, etc.) in your item box.

packages.name: smwblocks-pay-to-end-level
packages.title: Pay To End Level
packages.description:
Here is a fixed version of my block.

When you hit this block, it will end the level if you have 30 coins.(You can change the amount)

packages.name: smwblocks-per-level-flags-detection-block
packages.title: Per-Level Flags Detection Block
packages.description: This simple block will change its act as (and optionally shatter) when touched, if a specific per-level flag is set (either "Invisible 1-Ups collected" flag, "All Dragon Coins collected" flag, "3-Up Moon collected" flag). Check the asm file for more info and options.

packages.name: smwblocks-perfect-slippery-blocks-v3-2
packages.title: Perfect Slippery Blocks v3.2.0
packages.description:
Unlike "Single Slippery Block", this one, you don't need an anti-slippery block placed above the slippery block for a workaround prevention. It also has proper slippery corners without making the whole level slippery. It requires Uberasm tool.

2023-09-13 update - supports both half and full slippery mode in one hack. Thus !Freeram_MarioSlip and !Freeram_SpriteSlip acts as a copy of RAM $86 (including $01-$7F being half-slippery and $80+ being fully slippery).

2023-05-07 update - supports LM override.

packages.name: smwblocks-pipe-cannon
packages.title: Pipe Cannon
packages.description:
This is a pipe cannon similar to the one New Super Mario Bros.
If the player enters it, instead of warping them to another level, it shoots them straight up into the air, locking their controls during launch.
Mario will keep going until he hits a ceiling, or one of 2 custom blocks: 
PipeCannon_End.asm
or 
PipeCannon_teleport.asm
.
Also included is a variant that will shoot the player when they press A or B instead of waiting for a timer.

Useful for a gimmick like getting to high areas disguised as a pipe to nowhere.

packages.name: smwblocks-pipe-kit
packages.title: Pipe Kit
packages.description:
These blocks act exactly like screen exit enabled pipes.

ASMers could use this for things like making a pipe that leads you to a defined exit, making a pipe you can enter but not exit that doesn't even take you to a screen exit and would be very cheap, or for the fact that you can make codes on a block activate only if you're on the left or right side of the top of a block.

packages.name: smwblocks-pipes-on-small-powerup
packages.title: Pipes on Small Powerup
packages.description: Both a horizontal and vertical pipe that the player can only enter when small. Note: the vertical pipes need both a left version (vleft.asm) and a right version (vright.asm) for it to work accurately. They need to be placed to the left and right of eachother, too. This problem doesn't quite apply to horizontal pipes.

packages.name: smwblocks-planted-sprite-block
packages.title: Planted Sprite Block
packages.description:
A disassembly of MikeyK's block, "MushBlk.bin". I added a few extra features, such as sound effects, and the ability to chose whether the sprite created is normal or custom. Its like ICB's Veggie Blocks, but doesn't crash the game when there are too many sprites on screen at once - it now doesn't activate when there are too many sprites.

PM me if you encounter any major errors. No credit needed.

packages.name: smwblocks-player-specific-block
packages.title: Player Specific Block
packages.description:
This block acts like a certain map16 tile depending on the current player. When it's not the player you specified, it will act like what you set it to act like in the map16 editor. When it's the one you specified, it will act like what you set it to act like in the .asm file.

Credit not needed since this is pretty simple.

packages.name: smwblocks-poison-water
packages.title: Poison Water
packages.description: This block makes the timer rapidly decrease for a bit every few seconds while you're in it.

packages.name: smwblocks-poundable-stake-blocks
packages.title: Poundable Stake Blocks
packages.description:
Similar to YI, if the player were to spinjump/groundpound the stake blocks, they will "shorten" (or move downward) without any possible cutoff being shown. Great for aesthetics and puzzles.

Also includes an upside down version.

packages.name: smwblocks-power-preserver
packages.title: Power Preserver
packages.description:
This block preserves your powerup, in that, when you hit it, it transfers your current powerup over to the item box, leaving the player small. If the player is already small, the "incorrect" sound will be generated.
This could be useful, as it makes you small without having to die / get hurt, perhaps making areas where you have to be small to pass acceptable. "Acts like" setting may be best as solid.

packages.name: smwblocks-power-up-blocks
packages.title: Power Up Blocks
packages.description:
Blocks, which sets Mario's power up state directly but as opposide to the cheap ones which can be practically made by everyone (even by a tool), these also include an animation to play for each state like you would have gotten the corresponding powerup or, in case with become_big.asm, a different animation for each powerup state à la my powerdown patch.
In additon, these disable flying with the cape to prevent glitches.

Absolutely no credits required.

note: become_big.asm works natively with more power ups but requires some edits to add powerdown animation for each power up.

packages.name: smwblocks-power-up-selector-block
packages.title: Power-Up Selector Block
packages.description:
This block will increase Mario's powerup status after jumping on block or hitting it from below. If Mario with Fire powerup ($03) contact with this block, it will reset him to Small Mario ($00).
(In future I will make version of this block, where selection can be done only once (or multiple times specified inside code.)
See "readme" for details.

packages.name: smwblocks-powerup-coin
packages.title: Powerup Coin
packages.description: A coin that gives the player a powerup of their choice, as well as a configurable amount of coins. Becomes solid when the blue P-Switch is active.

packages.name: smwblocks-powerup-conditional-coin
packages.title: Powerup Conditional Coin
packages.description: This coin will give you an amount of coins based on the player's powerup status. You can change the values in the only table in the ASM File.

packages.name: smwblocks-powerup-dependent-block
packages.title: Powerup-Dependent Block
packages.description: This block will act like a different original block depending on your current powerup!

packages.name: smwblocks-powerup-dependent-reward-block
packages.title: Powerup-Dependent Reward Block
packages.description: When the player hits this block from below, he will get a reward depending on his powerup. The block will also destroy itself.

packages.name: smwblocks-powerup-increment
packages.title: Powerup Increment
packages.description: When touched, this block will increase the player's powerup status and then shatter. Increments go in this order: Small > Big > Fiery > Caped > Star. Also comes with a version that sticks with Fiery, it doesn't go to Caped or Star.

packages.name: smwblocks-powerup-life-exchange
packages.title: Powerup Life Exchange
packages.description: Contains two blocks. Power_Exchange.asm works as following: If the player isn't small, it takes away his power up in exchange for one life, otherwise plays the "incorrect" sound. The other block does the same, but has a different amount of lives to exchange for the powerup, depending on the powerup. This amount can be changed easily.

packages.name: smwblocks-powerup-swap
packages.title: Powerup Swap
packages.description:
These blocks are helpful when you don't want the player to have a certain powerup in a puzzle.
The first block, nocape.asm, will change Cape Mario to Fire Mario and will replace a cape feather in the item box with a fire flower.
The second, nofire.asm does the reverse.
Both blocks will leave Mario's powerup status unaffected if he is small or big, and they won't modify the item in the item box if it isn't a fire flower/cape feather.

packages.name: smwblocks-press-any-key-to-activate-normal-exit
packages.title: Press Any Key To Activate Normal Exit
packages.description: Press Any Key To Activate Normal Exit (PAKTANE) is a block which will activate normal exit of the level you are in if you press any key when inside this block. Made on request by REQUESTMAN.

versions.title: Press Any Key To Activate Normal Exit

packages.name: smwblocks-pressable-on-off-switch
packages.title: Pressable ON/OFF Switch
packages.description:
Give credit if used.

Requested by MachoMan

onoff.asm = if mario is on it, change the on/off switch to on
offon.asm = if mario is on it, change the on/off switch to off
switchon.asm = change on/off status to on
switchoff.asm = change on/off status to off

Video: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8HfKVdQMyE8

packages.name: smwblocks-puff-block
packages.title: Puff Block
packages.description: This block will disappear in a puff of smoke when hit from below.

packages.name: smwblocks-puffy-cloud
packages.title: Puffy Cloud
packages.description: This is a cloud which will disappear in a puff of smoke when spinjumped. It also plays a SFX.

packages.name: smwblocks-purple-coins
packages.title: Purple Coins
packages.description:
A replica of the purple coins from Super Mario Galaxy. Collect a certain amount of them (customisable) and activate something (also customisable).
These coins stay collected if you switch to a different room.

Be sure to read the readme before inserting the coins!

Requested by MrMartley64.

packages.name: smwblocks-quake
packages.title: Quake
packages.description: This block will shake the ground, stun the player and sprites when touched. It then erases itself. It can play a configurable sound effect too.

packages.name: smwblocks-question-mark-blocks
packages.title: Question Mark Blocks
packages.description:
A pack with some very customisable question mark blocks including a power up dependent block (similar how the flower and feather ?-blocks from the original game act like), a block to spawn enemy sprites, Yoshi eggs, place an item to the item box, giant versions of them and a giant coin block.
You can change the sprite (obviously), the initial sprite state (for carryable and some other sprites), the power up out of block/ stun/ random sprite timer (depending on the sprite), the sound effect, some bounce block settings including properties too and even whether the block is dependand from the item memory or not (requires the included object).

Be aware that due to unoptimised routines (not my fault, really), the giant blocks can cause black lines on top of the screen or glitch the HDMA for one frame.
To minimise the chances of it happening, you can apply the VRAM optimisation patch.

Read the readme for more information.
Also thanks for LX5 for two routines and the Yoshi egg blocks.

packages.name: smwblocks-quicksand
packages.title: Quicksand
packages.description:
This block will slow Mario down and make it more difficult to jump.

Unlike previous iterations, this doesn't nullify the player's X or Y speed immediately and acts a bit more like the hazard in Super Mario Bros. 2, where you can still maintain your speed by jumping out as soon as you touch its surface.
As well, some sprites, like the Pokey and some jumping sprites, will be completely unaffected by the block, acting like solid ground in these instances.

Defines exist in the ASM file to dictate how much his X and Y speeds are constrained, as well as how sprites behave with the block.

Release History:
- 7/9/2022 (C3 Summer 2022): V1.0 - Limited Initial Release.
- 10/27/2023: V1.1 - Updated sprite handling. Now "stuns" Koopas and Goombas and flips them vertically.

packages.name: smwblocks-quicksand-blocks
packages.title: Quicksand Blocks
packages.description: These are two quicksand blocks. One, QuicksandNorm.asm, acts like you would expect it to - it drags the player and sprites down and decreases their horizontal speed to an extent. The other block, QuicksandPit.asm makes movement even more difficult for both player and sprites.

packages.name: smwblocks-race-against-death
packages.title: Race Against Death
packages.description: This block kills the player when touched by ANY sprite, but teleports the player when he touches it.

packages.name: smwblocks-random-block
packages.title: Random ? Block
packages.description:
? Block will a random item in it. You can configure the items in the table in the .ASM.
Note that the table must contain eight entries and that it contains map16 tile numbers, so there's some limits on what you can generate.

packages.name: smwblocks-random-item-box-item-v1
packages.title: Random Item Box Item v1.5
packages.description:
These blocks will put a random item into your item box. Please read the included Readme for for more info.

Please give credit, if used.

v1.5: Optimized the code a bit. Now uses 'if' instead of 'CMP'.

packages.name: smwblocks-ransom-block
packages.title: Ransom Block
packages.description: If you do not have at least a set amount of coins, you will get killed. If you do, however, you are rewarded with a set sprite.

packages.name: smwblocks-red-coin
packages.title: Red Coin
packages.description:
A block that acts like a coin, however:
- You get an extra life when you collect 5 of those
- It doesn't turn into a brick when you press a blue P-switch. (The graphics still change, however. You have to change the coin graphics yourself if you want it to look correctly when blue P-switches are used.)

Made for Weegee100's request

packages.name: smwblocks-red-coin-v2
packages.title: Red Coin v2.1
packages.description:
A red coin, if the player collects X amount of them, they get a power-up as a reward. It also plays a sound effect when collected.
They can be set to only be collectable when a p-switch is active, and additionally, there's an option to stop the p-switch timer when all the coins have been collected.
To make them not visible while a blue switch isn't active, use the graphic tiles that are already in the game, that are used for the invisible p-coins (there's an image file included as help in addition to a map16 file). For the silver switch variant, use exanimations (the animation can be found in the example level, so you can just copy it from there), for normal non-switch variant, once again, use a custom animation (to avoid the block turning into used blocks when a blue p-switch is active. This animation can also be found in the example level).
Everything is configurable in the file.

Inspired by NSMB's red coins.

v2.0 update:
- I rewrote the entire code. It's a lot more configurable and optimized now.
v2.1 update:
- Added more customizability.
- No longer relies on the item box.

packages.name: smwblocks-relative-teleport-blocks-1
packages.title: Relative teleport blocks 1.3
packages.description: A special teleport block that keeps the player's physics during transition to another level. Good for cross-level effects.

packages.name: smwblocks-remove-carried-item
packages.title: Remove Carried Item
packages.description: This item will remove the item the player is currently carrying. More information can be found in the .asm file.

packages.name: smwblocks-remove-carryable-items
packages.title: Remove Carryable Items
packages.description:
This block removes any carryable item, including those stored in yoshi's mouth.

A couple notes:
-Sprites that can be stunned won't be removed untill they are (koopas, walking bob-ombs, galoombas, etc.)

-Items stuck on yoshi's tongue won't be removed (they probably disable object interaction, idk)

Credit is optional.

packages.name: smwblocks-remove-yoshi-upon-entering-a-room
packages.title: Remove Yoshi upon entering a room
packages.description:
I had trouble with existing castle entrance patches and blocks, not sure if it was a patch conflict.
Anyway I made this simple block that checks if mario is riding Yoshi, and sets the flag to remove him upon entering the next room. Should Mario die or pass the level, Yoshi will reappear on the overworld.

versions.title: Remove Yoshi upon entering a room

packages.name: smwblocks-repressable-button-switch-2
packages.title: Repressable button switch 2.1
packages.description:
This button switch, when triggered, will change map16 and flips the on/off switch (by default, you can change it in the block's asm file), and if the player gets off the switch, it will revert back into its unpressed state so the player can use it again. Read the readme for more info.

Fixed the yoshi bug and added a palette + palettemask, and when placed on the left or top edge of level.

packages.name: smwblocks-reset-yoshi-coin-count
packages.title: Reset Yoshi Coin Count
packages.description:
This block resets the Yoshi Coin counter.
Also clears the flag if all have been collected but only if the level hasn't been exited in the meantime.
- get 5 coins - touch block - flag cleared.
- get 5 coins - win/die - reenter level - touch block - flag remains.
(see ASM on to make it always delete the flag)

packages.name: smwblocks-reverse-muncher
packages.title: Reverse Muncher
packages.description: This is the opposite of a muncher; a coin when the silver P-switch is off, and a muncher when the silver P-switch is on.

packages.name: smwblocks-reverting-map16-blocks-v2-0
packages.title: Reverting Map16 Blocks v2.0.3
packages.description: These block package, when these blocks gets changed or deleted, will revert back after a few frames or so. Useful for puzzle or switches that needs to be reused (without the use of a sprite). Note that Yoshi is incompatible with most of these.

packages.name: smwblocks-rex-manipulation-block
packages.title: Rex Manipulation Block
packages.description:
This block smushes a Rex and makes an already smushed rex normal again. Afterwards, the block destroys itself.
Uses Palette 7.

packages.name: smwblocks-rock-climb-blocks
packages.title: Rock Climb Blocks
packages.description:
These 2 blocks act as "mini ledges" that can only be stand on if the player does the following:

-Not crouching
-Holding in the direction towards the wall.
-Touching the wall, a pixel or more away does not count.

packages.name: smwblocks-ropes
packages.title: Ropes
packages.description: This Block works like tile 105 from the original game. But they are flipped in all directions (this one also works for sprites).

packages.name: smwblocks-rotating-boost-block
packages.title: Rotating boost block
packages.description:
Adopted from the old block tool block.

This block uses lunar magic's examination to determine which direction should the boost block shoots mario. It has a customizable table in which you modify the velocity. See readme for details.

packages.name: smwblocks-run-on-water
packages.title: Run On Water
packages.description: A block that if the player runs above at max speed, it is solid. Otherwise, it is water that the player can swim through.

packages.name: smwblocks-save-block
packages.title: Save block
packages.description:
This block will play a sound (default: midway) and save the game when the player presses down.

Requested by Gi Manilla

packages.name: smwblocks-screen-scrolling-doors
packages.title: Screen Scrolling Doors
packages.description:
This door, when entered will take Mario to another location within the same level without having to refresh the screen.

Note that Yoshi also turns invisible when entering doors. So make sure that you make it impossible to have Yoshi in the places that you are gonna use these doors.

packages.name: smwblocks-selective-sprite-only-block
packages.title: Selective Sprite Only Block
packages.description:
A "sprite only" block that you can customize. Enable or disable a sprite's interaction by setting its corresponding bit in the tables.
One table for vanilla sprites, one table for custom sprites -- 32 bytes each.

There's also defines to customize other aspects of the block -- whether it interacts with stunned sprites, Mario, fireballs and cape -- as well to change the "act like" setting for when a sprite (or anything else) doesn't interact with the block.

All relevant information is included within the asm file -- including about how to use and which sprites are enabled or disabled by default.

Oh, and it's compatible with both LoROM and sa1.

Have fun!

packages.name: smwblocks-sell-powerup
packages.title: Sell Powerup
packages.description: You can sell your powerup with this custom block, with coins in return. Of course, the sound effects and the amount of money you gain is adjustable. Don't even think of crediting me.

packages.name: smwblocks-sensitive-bridge
packages.title: Sensitive Bridge
packages.description:
If the player is small, he can walk across it. Otherwise, it shatters under his weight.

Note: Only shatters when the player is standing on top of the block (or on the top corners).

packages.name: smwblocks-shatter-after-player-touch-v2
packages.title: Shatter After Player Touch v2.0
packages.description:
This custom block will shatter after the player gets off it. Good for platforming stages or places where you jump a lot to dodge stuff.

Requested by Final Theory.

Changelog
v2.0 (Arinsu)
---
- Added SA-1 compatibility.
- Changed the included sprite to a bounce sprite.
- Simplified the code a lot.

packages.name: smwblocks-shatter-on
packages.title: Shatter On 50 Bonus Stars
packages.description: A block that will shatter if Mario / Luigi has 50 Bonus Stars. Based on the "Shop Block 1-Up by InfiniteCoinBlock." Credit for me is not needed, but if you want to give it, give it to him.

packages.name: smwblocks-shatter-on-coin-count
packages.title: Shatter On Coin Count
packages.description: Contains two blocks. 32coinsbreak.asm shatters when the player touches it and has more than the set amount of coins (by default, 32), while CoinSubtractShatter.asm shatters if the player has at least one coin, and then takes away a coin from the total.

packages.name: smwblocks-shatter-on-pack
packages.title: Shatter On ... Pack
packages.description:
A pack which contains the following blocks:
- Shatters on contact with player or sprites
- Shatters on contact with sprites
- Shatters on contact with player
- Shatters on contact with fireballs
- Shatters on contact with cape

packages.name: smwblocks-shatter-on-sprite-touch
packages.title: Shatter on Sprite Touch
packages.description: This block will break when one of the specified sprites touches it. Can be customized; see the .asm file.

packages.name: smwblocks-shatter-on-star
packages.title: Shatter on Star
packages.description: This block shatters if you have a star.

packages.name: smwblocks-shatter-x-on-off-sensitive-blocks
packages.title: Shatter x ON/OFF Sensitive Blocks
packages.description:
These blocks kind of work like regular sensitive blocks. However, when a specific amount of these are shattered by Mario (initially set to 3), they play around with the ON/OFF flag either setting it to on (in this case, the "Shatter x" ON Sensitive Block) or setting it to off (the "Shatter x" OFF Sensitive Block). The amount of blocks needed to be shattered to the ON/OFF flag routine be read can be easily specified in the ASM files for each block.

Credit isn't necessary, but would be nice. Enjoy!

packages.name: smwblocks-shattering-smb2-pow
packages.title: Shattering SMB2 POW
packages.description: When the player touches it, the block will kill all sprites on screen like the SMB2 POW, and then it shatters itself.

packages.name: smwblocks-shop-block
packages.title: Shop block - 6 digit coin counter
packages.description:
Special thanks for spigmike who help me to create this block.
This is a very customisable shop block who works perfectly with the "6 digit coin counter" patch.
You can buy item for more than 100 coins ^^

packages.name: smwblocks-shop-block-using-lives
packages.title: Shop Block Using Lives
packages.description: A regular shop block, but instead of using coins, it uses lives.

packages.name: smwblocks-shop-blocks
packages.title: Shop Blocks
packages.description: A bundle of shop blocks, all of which are very customizable. You can configure which RAM it uses (coins, Yoshi coins, etc.), the price of the item, which item it gives, whether a message is played if the player doesn't have enough coins and more.

packages.name: smwblocks-shop-blocks-on-bonus-star-count
packages.title: Shop Blocks on Bonus Star Count
packages.description:
This is just like the other shop blocks, but this is for Bonus Stars - I did NOT base these of them, I coded them myself, and Alcaro helped a bit as well.

It has blocks for Mushrooms, Starman, Cape and Fire Flower - And prices can be changed in the ASM file

versions.title: Shop Blocks on Bonus Star Count

packages.name: smwblocks-shop-items-and-power-ups
packages.title: Shop Items and Power Ups
packages.description:
Highly customizable shop blocks for buying items and power ups, with different kinds of currencies.

Commissioned by DrAnas.

Features:
  • You can buy items for the item box (mushroom, feather, fire flower, star)
  • You can buy power ups for the player (small, big, cape, fire).
  • You can customize any combination of currencies (bonus stars, coins, lives, score) and amounts required to buy from the shop block.
  • The shop blocks come in two fashions: "go through" and "hit from below".
  • Blocks can be customized to have infinite availability, or just one item for sale (then the block is disabled/disappears).
  • Included a `check_and_pay` routine that can be used to create other blocks that require similar payments (e.g., pay to toggle the ON/OFF switch, spawn a sprite, etc.).
  • SA-1 compatible.

Detailed instructions are found in the readme and in the block files.

packages.name: smwblocks-shovel-knight-snow-block
packages.title: Shovel Knight - Snow Block
packages.description:
This floating pile of snow, when touched by the player or sprite, spawns a falling snow sprite (and deletes the block). If the sprite hits the ground with spikes on it, it will cover the spikes so the player can safely walk on it.

10/30/2022

Now Sa-1 hybrid.

packages.name: smwblocks-sign-block
packages.title: Sign Block
packages.description: A block that displays a message when you touch it and press UP. Also lets you configure the message number to display, as well as the level number to read from.

packages.name: smwblocks-simple-walljump
packages.title: Simple Walljump
packages.description:
Simple wall jump block used in Super Foo World. Some people asked for this.


- Block will activate even without the player holding against the wall
- will launch the player quite far if dpad is neutraled
- preserves type of jump (normal, spin, duck)

packages.name: smwblocks-slide-interactable-blocks
packages.title: slide-interactable blocks
packages.description:
These blocks have unique gimmick when mario is sliding, these include:
-a "ramp" (actually the custom block is being place above it) from SMB3 that if Mario gain momentum from sliding downwards and press jump when hitting the ramp, will make Mario do a long jump, the arrow gfx for that is optional, you can use a blank tile.
-a solid block that can break if Mario slides into them.
-a "continue slider" that keeps mario sliding indefinitely if he prior slides into them, the modifyable speeds are the "minimal" speeds that moves mario if slower.
-a passable bridge that is only solid when mario is sliding on it (without falling onto it)
-and much more..

These are useful for puzzle and slide based levels.

packages.name: smwblocks-slippy-pole
packages.title: Slippy pole
packages.description:
When holding directly down the player will start sliding down this net.

Note: You can modify this block to allow Mario to punch the net if desirable.

Requested by FinalTheory

packages.name: smwblocks-slope-edge-fix-block
packages.title: Slope Edge Fix Block
packages.description:
This block allows you to have an instant dropoff from a slope, rather than having to place a one-tile ledge before the dropoff.

See readme.txt for more info.

This block does not require the reserve.ips that is included with BMF's non-BTSD version.

Now contains intersection tiles for grassland levels.

(Shiny Ninetales): Minor update, now it is SA-1 hybrid and contains tiles for underground and rope levels.

packages.name: smwblocks-slowfall
packages.title: SlowFall
packages.description: This block will reduce your falling speed by a set amount (defaults are provided).  You can use this with the cape, but it won't make that much of a difference in speed.  Different falling speeds are set depending on whether or not the B/A buttons are held.

packages.name: smwblocks-smash-blocks
packages.title: Smash Blocks v4
packages.description: This is a solid block that will shatter only upon caped Mario smashing on top of it, or Yoshi with a yellow shell in its mouth stomping it.

packages.name: smwblocks-smb2-health-filling-blocks
packages.title: SMB2 Health filling blocks
packages.description:
If you applied the SMB2 styled health patch then you can use this block to fully refill the health meter. Itrefills the health if it's hit from below.
If you want it to be useable for only one time then make it act like tile 129.
If you want it to be permanent then make it act like tile 130.

Zip file comes with:
-a block that fill one the health
-a block that fills the health for free
-a block that needs coins
-a block that's compatible with the 6 digit coin counter

Added SA-1

packages.name: smwblocks-smb3-brick
packages.title: SMB3 Brick
packages.description:
This is a SMB3 brick block. Comes with a readme for changing it into: SMB1 brick, SMB1 brick (Demo world style), SMB3 brick, SMB3 brick (DWS), SMB3 coin, SMB3 coin (DWS). v1.3: better way to do the last two.

v1.4: fixed the glitch that a mushroom comes out when small mario hits a block.

packages.name: smwblocks-smb3-p-switch-block-set
packages.title: SMB3 P-Switch Block Set
packages.description:
This is a set of blocks that imitate the P-Switch Blocks from Super Mario Bros. 3. smb3pswitch.asm is the actual P-Switch, and smb3pswblock.asm is a block that spawns the block. You have to adjust the Map16 number in the .asm file. Various other things can be changed too.

This fixes the problem where it wouldn't spawn if hit with sprites. LX5 fixed it by rewriting it.

Also included with it are additional routine macros (mandatory for this block to work.)

Credit goes to LX5 and Koyuki (Mirumo) for the originals!

packages.name: smwblocks-solid-if-all-switch-palaces-beaten
packages.title: Solid if all Switch Palaces beaten
packages.description: A block that is solid only if all 4 switch palaces are pressed.

versions.title: Solid if all Switch Palaces beaten

packages.name: smwblocks-solid-if-running-block
packages.title: Solid if Running Block
packages.description: Inspired by the sheer surfaces seen in Sonic Chaos' Gigalopolis and Mecha Green Hill Zones, this block will be solid if Mario is running at at least a certain speed, but passable if he isn't.

packages.name: smwblocks-solid-magikoopa-magic-block
packages.title: Solid Magikoopa Magic Block
packages.description: A simple solid block like a cement block that can be affected by Magikoopa's magic spells.

packages.name: smwblocks-solid-on-powerup
packages.title: Solid on Powerup
packages.description: This block acts as a cement block only if the player has a certain defined powerup (#$00-#$03 from RAM $7E:0019, see RAM map).

packages.name: smwblocks-sonic-monitors
packages.title: Sonic Monitors
packages.description:
These are blocks that recreate the monitors from Sonic the Hedgehog. Now with a few changes and 2 new monitors. Enjoy.

Moderator's comment: you actually have to 'break' the block by jumping on it. I had difficulties figuring this out

packages.name: smwblocks-special-boost-blocks-pack
packages.title: Special Boost Blocks Pack
packages.description: This pack contains all the Boost Blocks I've ever made by myself, including some ON/OFF Boost Blocks. Credit would be nice.

packages.name: smwblocks-special-coin
packages.title: Special Coin
packages.description:
A special kind of coin.

If mario collects 5 of these, he will be turn big if he was small, turn into Fire Mario if he was big, or get a 1-up if he was Fire or Cape Mario.

Powerup changing also plays the sound effect and animation.

The graphics still change into the brick if mario hits a blue POW, you have to change the graphics yourself if you want to fix that.

packages.name: smwblocks-special-note-block
packages.title: Special Note Block
packages.description:
A block that will shoot the player in the sky and warp to level 1C8.

Note: Do not make it act like a note block, as the bounce sprite will overwrite it.

packages.name: smwblocks-special-world-block
packages.title: Special World Block
packages.description: This block, when hit from below by Mario, will activate the special world flag changing the OW colours and such. It also plays sound effects and can be reverted to normal if it's hit again.

packages.name: smwblocks-specific-screen-conditional-vertical-exit-enabled-pipe
packages.title: Specific Screen + Conditional Vertical Exit-Enabled Pipe
packages.description:
Similar to the specific screen teleport blocks, this vertical pipe will teleport you to a specific screen exit. It can also be set up to teleport to a different screen exit depending on a condition, such as the P-switch being active, the number of exits collected and much more.

Make sure to edit the settings file and keep it in the blocks folder, but don't insert it directly - only insert the left and right blocks.

versions.title: Specific Screen + Conditional Vertical Exit-Enabled Pipe

packages.name: smwblocks-specific-screen-teleport-block-door-v1
packages.title: Specific screen teleport block & door v1.2
packages.description:
Unlike all exit enabled things (door, pipe, and teleport block), this one will not use the current screen exit that the block is placed, instead you can make it use a specific screen's exit's destination.

Useful if you wanted multiple teleport blocks each with its own destination on the same boundary or so you don't have to have multiple teleport blocks with each with its own specfic level on each map16 blocks.

Includes:
-A teleport block that uses a specific screen
-A teleport block that uses one of two screens depending on what the conditions are (on/off switch, p-switch, star, etc).
-A "random" teleport block that uses one of four screens (not truly random since it uses a frame counter because I don't know how to use the random number generator).
-A door version of the three above.

v1.2
-----
Fixed a bug doors wouldn't work in layer2 enabled levels. Player gravity check was wrong. Reported by Shog64.

v1.1
---------
Support for extended levels (LM3). Only works with GPS 1.4.0 +

packages.name: smwblocks-spike-donut
packages.title: Spike Donut
packages.description: Downward spike + donut lift.

packages.name: smwblocks-spin-jump-block-pack
packages.title: Spin Jump Block Pack
packages.description:
This block when spin jumped on or when landed on while riding Yoshi will launch the player up in to the air. The height the player is launched depends on if the player was holding the A or B button.

Comes in four variations:
1. Behaves like the map16 tile it is set to if the doesn't spin jump on it or land on it while riding Yoshi.
2. Damages the player if not spin jumping on it or landing on it while riding Yoshi.
3. Shatters if spin jumped on or landed on while riding Yoshi, otherwise damages the player.
4. Disappears in a poof of smoke if spin jumped on or landed on while riding Yoshi, otherwise damages the player.

The code is intentionally verbose to make changing certain aspects easier and there's an included readme that outlines what you need to do if you don't want the player to bounce on these blocks while riding Yoshi.

packages.name: smwblocks-spin-jumping-block
packages.title: Spin Jumping Block
packages.description: When Mario stands on it, it makes him do a spin jump. If you are not small Mario, the block will explode like a turn block.

packages.name: smwblocks-spiny-and-swooper-blocks
packages.title: Spiny and Swooper Blocks

This package includes two blocks: one that acts like a mid-air Spiny Egg, and the other like a stationary Swooper. They can be defeated by shells, throw blocks, fireballs, cape, and star power. They interact with Mario almost the same way their sprite counterparts do. Notable exceptions are that Yoshi cannot eat them, and they won't turn into silver coins when a silver p-switch is pressed.

Since these do not take sprite slots, they can be extremely useful to put as obstacles in certain situations and setups where sprite slots are limited.

- Added the possibility of having the blocks spawn a coin when hit by a fireball.

A Block that will break from the bottom when hit by a thrown object. Included is the block and the source (that's there if you want a bin file)

packages.name: smwblocks-sprite-shatter-blocks

packages.name: smwblocks-sprite-shell-speed-limiter

packages.name: smwblocks-star-block

packages.description:
When the player touches the block he gets a Star in his box and then the block will destroy itself.

With an optional pay feature to pay for the star. Look into the ASM file to enable this feature.

packages.name: smwblocks-star-speed-block

A very solid block. Can be broken only if Mario has a star and is at max speed.

Converted [BT] to [BTSD] by DiscoMan, SA-1 hybridization by Major Flare.

packages.description: Unlike smw's p-switches, these p-switches are stationary and can be used multiple times, useful for puzzle levels for those who dislike having to reset.

packages.name: smwblocks-sticky-ceiling

packages.description:
A ceiling that the player will stick to when going upwards and holding a Jump button.

Enemies will also stick to the ceiling as long as they have upwards vertical speed. Sprites in "Stunned" or "Thrown" state will stick to the ceiling until they either move away from it, or the player grabs it.

When going downwards, the player and any sprite will just fall through.

Represented by Yellow Glass in the gif set.

packages.name: smwblocks-sticky-floor
packages.title: Sticky Floor
packages.description:
This block prevents Mario from moving horizontally. You may choose to disable Mario's ability to turn around as well, although this behaviour is enabled by default.

Compatible with most any solid/ledge tile (I can't officially recommend slopes, but it sort of works).

packages.name: smwblocks-strong-block
packages.title: Strong Block
packages.description: Only shatters/breaks from below if the player has a Mushroom (not a flower or cape). The required powerup can be adjusted.

packages.name: smwblocks-super-bounce-blocks
packages.title: Super Bounce Blocks
packages.description:
These are configurable bounce blocks that will bounce Mario and sprites UP! Unlike some other bounce blocks these will actually bounce sprites up when entering from the side.
Amazing features include:
Preserves X speed!
On/Off Shenanigans!
Settings to not interact with sprites / Mario.
GFX/ExGFX files included!

packages.name: smwblocks-super-mario
packages.title: Super Mario 64 Lava
packages.description: My first custom block. Stick it under your normal lava surface. The player will take damage and bounce high into the air. If already small, he'll die. Kills sprites on contact too.

packages.name: smwblocks-super-mario-3d-land-plus-clock
packages.title: Super Mario 3D Land - Plus Clock
packages.description:
A set of blocks which replicate the Plus Clocks from, among others, Super Mario 3D Land.
These can add either 10 seconds or 100 seconds of time by default but the value is customisable.

Comes with two versions: One which just adds time to the time and another which spawns a score sprite and add some time that way.

No credits necessary.

packages.name: smwblocks-super-mario-bros
packages.title: Super Mario Bros. 2 - Mushroom Block
packages.description:
An updated and optimized version of the SMB2 Mushroom Block. It can be picked up from above, and after it's dropped, the sprite will revert back to a block.

Note that it can cause cutoff when reverting to a block in places with non-solid decoration.

This was part of mikeyk's SMB2 Updated sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

packages.name: smwblocks-super-mario-bros-3-screen-scrolling-pipes-v4-0
packages.title: Super Mario Bros. 3 Screen Scrolling Pipes v4.0.4
packages.description:
See tutorial here. The blocks section has a small 1MIB limit preventing me from submitting this as a whole.

These pipes, when entered, will cause the player to travel through them within the same level rather than refreshing the screen. Useful for maze levels for those who refuse to use screen exits.

Notes:
* If there are at least 2 sprites on screen, and Mario enters a pipe, he will partially disappear as he enters a pipe. You should patch NMSTL to prevent that.
* If you have a low-gravity generator that does 
DEC $7D
(Mario's Y speed), make sure that you add a check that if $9D is nonzero, or the low nibble (low 4 bits, %----XXXX) of RAM address 
!pipe_dir
is non-zero, then skip/return, because otherwise Mario will rise up slowly while traveling through horizontal pipes. You absolutely don't want to touch his physics while inside pipes.

GitHub: https://github.com/GhbSmwc/SMB3_ScreenScrollingPipes

Changelog
01-01-2025 4.0.3

	-Fixed an oversight where some sprites still interacts with the player while inside a pipe, such as

	 a boo ring. Give thanks to AmperSam for reporting on it.

12/26/2025 4.0.4

	-Bug fixes:

	--Fixed a missing TopCorner for small pipes that I forgot to include for small-mario-only pipes.

	--Fixed a problem where sprite interaction with the player during pipe travel still happens (lose yoshi)

	  when the player is riding yoshi.

	--Fixed a problem where if player is off yoshi, and enters a pipe and turns invisible, so too will

	  yoshi. Credit to AmperSam (https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=profile&id=41223). Note that this isn't a

	  true fix since yoshi checks if RAM $78 is #$FF would hide him. Problem is that the yoshi routine

	  that checks the RAM is hijacked by SA-1.

	--Fixed a minor visual quirk where if the player crouch-slide into the top of a pipe and enters it,

	  the player will retain his crouching state throughout the pipe travel.

	--Fixed an issue with Warp/Drag mode in SA-1 breaking on accurate emulators (when applied to SA-1 game,

	  the main pipes code for UAT's gamemode 14 would still run in SNES CPU, runs an aiming routine that

	  would use SA-1 math registers, which would fail). This now invokes SA-1 when the game is SA-1.

	--Fixed a slight error where dying the same frame the player enters a pipe with !Setting_SSP_FreezeTime

	  set to 1 would cause an abrupt fade out on the dying animation.

	--Fixed a bug where yoshi turning around animation persists when traveling through vertical pipes.

	--Made horizontal pipes also set X position and vertical pipes set Y position in addition to centering

	  the player so that the player goes from entering to stem state at a consistent position (sprites,

	  wind generators or anything that would position the player slightly off can affect this).

	-Added an optional fix for camera panning to allow the camera to pan in the direction the player is

	 facing when enabling freezing during pipe travel (previously, the camera would pan in front of

	 player's facing when the freeze setting is off, but does not do so when on).

	-Player's XY Subpixels position (RAM $13DA and $13DC) updates:

	--Centering codes now also sets the player's XY subpixel position, thus movement no longer have a 1

	  pixel variance of the player's XY position upon exiting pipe caps.

	--Made an extremely minor change on "Fixes.asm" to include clearing the player's Y position subpixel

	  when standing on layer 1 & 2 platforms.

	 -Moved several block codes to subroutines:

	--Vertical centering code (accounting for whether or not riding yoshi or powerup states) now moved

	  to subroutines.

	--Majority of the code handling exiting vertical pipe caps and turn corners now moved to block

	  subroutines, saving significant space.

	-!Freeram_SSP_EntrExtFlg updated to now have values for entering, stem traveling, exiting normally,

	 and cannon exiting. Also the defines now reflect on this.

	-Renamed several routine files to have a "SSP" at the beginning of the name using freeram of screen

	 scrolling pipes (It's better to have ASM resource-specific routines have their name (in this case,

	 "screen scrolling pipes") in so that (1) reduce the risk of filename conflicts, and (2) be more

	 informative that it is resource-specific).

	-Vertical regular-sized pipe caps and turn corners will now check if the player is centered enough to

	 trigger them. This allows setups like seen here:

	 "Readme_files/VerticalExitCapsRequirePlayerCenteredHorizontally.png"

	--Did a similar thing with the warp/drag mode block as well as the new "set_visibility_off.asm" and

	  "set_visibility_on.asm", however it accepts both single-block centered and 2-block centered (half

	  block to the right).

	-Added an option !Setting_SSP_HideDuringPipeStemTravel, which can be set to 0 so that the player and

	 carried sprite does not turn invisible inside pipes, ideal for glass pipes.

	-Map16 files for LM's map16 and tile list for GPS for "v2" versions now have page 4 and page 5 merged

	 rather than having one file per-page.

	-Depreciated files:

	--Deleted the old version of the map16 blocks and for the GPS tool.

	--Got rid of the old level file since it is now depreciated and causing confusion.

	-Made moving blocks to a different block number for blocks list for GPS much MUCH easier, by including

	 a tool, "JS_GPSBlockListRelocator.html" which will offset them to a different map16 number.

	-Facing directions are now corrected when traveling through pipes rather than just when the player

	 exits horizontal pipe caps, so that the player doesn't appear going backwards in glass pipes.

	-The uberasm tool code is no longer a library code to be called from a gamemode 14 ASM file, because

	 UAT2.0 now supports multiple separate ASM files for the same N where N is the level/gamemode/

	 overworld number to apply its effects on.

	-Added a per-level wraparound feature for warp-drag mode: If the player pipe traveling heads into the

	 edge of a level, will send him to the opposite edge of the level. If V/H scrolling disabled, then

	 wraparound will adjust to be the screen's width. It also comes with an extra byte setting to also

	 invert along the edge.

	-Added a uberasm tool level file that adds wraparound effect for screen scrolling pipes when the

	 traveling player hits the edge of the level.

	-Several removed freerams:

	--Late discovery that somebody (MarioFanGamer) found that RAM $8F is a reliable copy of $72 for

	  checking if Mario is on the ground. Thus, freeram !Freeram_BlockedStatBkp will optionally not be used

	  (!Setting_SSP_CopyRAM77 set to 0 by default to not use a freeram).

	--Removing !Freeram_SSP_CarrySpr would still works with carried sprites. Thus this is redundant.

	-Added optional Freeram: !Freeram_SSP_InvisbleFlag, due to having both visible and invisible states for

	 doors and glass pipe support (will be used if !Setting_SSP_HideDuringPipeStemTravel == 0).

	-Added walking animation for horizontal pipe caps (note that it runs the vanilla code that handles

	 walking animations, as seen when $71 == #$05), which are JSL $00CEB1, JSL $00CFBC and

	 JSR $00D1F4. Finally fulfilled RPG Hacker's recommendation (https://smwc.me/s/41236/12725 ).

	-Moved aiming routine used by warp/drag mode to newer uberasm tool's routines.

	-Added an optional feature for warp/drag mode to make the player move faster if the destination is far

	 away enough.

	-Renamed various defines that start with "!SSP" with "!Setting_SSP" for consistency.

	-Sound effects can now be configured.

packages.name: smwblocks-super-mario-bros-wonder-marimba-blocks
packages.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder - Marimba Blocks
packages.description:
Those silly little noteblock variants from Super Mario Bros. Wonder! You can walk or run on them, and when you jump, it bounces you up!

The block has a few configuration options you'll need to set in the block. Please read the README to learn what to set!

The sprite also has configuration options for the palettes it uses, the sprite tile, and how high it launches the player.

Further usage instructions are in the README.

NOTE: Dismounting Yoshi on top of one of these blocks will still bounce you high.

versions.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder - Marimba Blocks

packages.name: smwblocks-super-speed-block
packages.title: Super Speed Block
packages.description:
From the request by Jimmy1up:
"Super Speed Block throws you slightly up and very fast in the direction you're facing. Bounces you off its Sides equally fast, but not up."

Logic bugs squashed by Ultimaximus.

packages.name: smwblocks-switch-pack
packages.title: Switch Pack
packages.description: This is a large pack of various switch-based blocks such as p-switch and on/off. Read the included readme for more information.

packages.name: smwblocks-switch-palace-switch
packages.title: Switch Palace Switch
packages.description:
A recreation of SMW's Switch Palace switches, down with using sprites for handling the pressed switch.

It comes with two sizes: 16x16 and 32x32, the former of which has two separate graphics (one being a downsized !-switch, the other being based of the p-switch).

packages.name: smwblocks-switchable-one-way-blocks
packages.title: Switchable One-Way Blocks
packages.description: This blocks Mario, sprites, and fireballs in one of two directions depending on a specified switch. Which directions and what switch can be easily changed.

packages.name: smwblocks-tar-blocks
packages.title: Tar Blocks
packages.description:
Tar blocks that cause the player to only jump as if they tapped the jump button once, effectively lowering their jump height. The player's speed is also limited if they try to walk across it.

tar_block.asm is the block, tar_uberasm.asm is for UberASMTool.

packages.name: smwblocks-target
packages.title: Target
packages.description:
This block will teleport you to another level (set in the .asm file) after you collected 8 (customizable) of it. They shatter when you touch them. Uses one byte of empty RAM - this address can be altered easily and has to be in the 16-bit range ($0000-$1FFF).

Knight of Time update: Works with SA-1 now.

packages.name: smwblocks-teleberry-block
packages.title: Teleberry block
packages.description: This block teleports Mario only when Yoshi has eaten a defined amount of red berries. It can set to play some sound too.

packages.name: smwblocks-teleport-based-on-time-remaining-v1
packages.title: Teleport Based on Time Remaining v1.1
packages.description:
A simple door block which teleports you to the screen exit if the timer is under a specified number, or else it teleports you to a specified secondary exit.

In the GIF, the player is teleported to different places depending on whether the timer is less than 100 or not.
Also please excuse the GIF's quality, I had to massively compress it to make it fit within the file size limit of 1MB, and as a result, lost most of its quality.

Requested by Rykon-V73.

v1.1 update 5/8/2021: added support for SA-1.

versions.title: Teleport Based on Time Remaining v1.1

Includes a define to invert the condition.

packages.name: smwblocks-teleport-on-button-press

packages.description: Teleports the player if they're pressing a specific button. Includes a variant that has two alternate destinations for different buttons.

packages.name: smwblocks-teleport-on-coins
packages.title: Teleport on Coins
