packages.description:
The ghost-like creature from SMW2:YI. It's similar to the Cloud Drop, but flies straightforward.

This sprite was part of Romi's Sprite Package, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

packages.name: smwsprites-hammer
packages.title: Hammer
packages.description: This is a disassembly of extended sprite 04 in SMW, Hammer.

packages.name: smwsprites-hammer-bro
packages.title: Hammer Bro
packages.description:
A Hammer Bro from Super Mario Bros. 3. It walks back and forth and sometimes jumps high between blocks. It frequently throws hammers in Mario's direction.

It throws an extended sprite hammer which is identical to the one bundled with PIXI but is still included for convenience. The included ExtendedGetDrawInfo fixes a crash in PIXI's, so it is highly recommended you replace it with it. The Sledge Bro uses the same hammer, so both sprites can share it.

Make sure to specify the extended sprite number of the hammer (extended/hammer.asm) from list.txt in the Hammer Bro's ASM file (sprites/HammerBro.asm)!

packages.name: smwsprites-hammer-bro-v1
packages.title: Hammer Bro v1.0
packages.description:
This guy walks back and forth, throwing hammers at Mario.

It uses the already in-game hammer.

v1.0
-----
Tattletale - moved out of pixi.

packages.name: smwsprites-hammer-brother-platform-line-guided
packages.title: Hammer Brother Platform, Line-Guided
packages.description:
This hammer brother platform (9C) will follow a line guide pattern similar to other platforms. It can also carry a hammer brother. (NOTE: tested with the vanilla hammer brother only. Any disassembly will require the hammer bro fix)

NOTE: Integrates the hammer bro fix.

packages.name: smwsprites-hammer-lotus
packages.title: Hammer Lotus
packages.description: A volcano lotus that shoots a hammers instead of pollen.

packages.name: smwsprites-hammer-plant
packages.title: Hammer Plant
packages.description:
This little plant will match mario's speed(one of two options), and chuck up hammers every now and then.

Now SA-1 compatible.

packages.name: smwsprites-hammer-sprite
packages.title: Hammer Sprite
packages.description:
- Name of Sprite: Hammer
- Insert as a sprite
- Uses extra bit
- Uses SP4
Description: Using the graphics from the castle destruction sequence, Mario can pick up this hammer and swing it madly, like the hammer from the original Donkey Kong or Smash Bros. You score 200 pts per hit, but the extra bit will let you gain 1UPs after 8 hits.

packages.name: smwsprites-hammerin-chuck
packages.title: Hammerin' Chuck
packages.description:
A pitchin' chuck except it throws hammers.
Setting the extra bit allows it to also throw hammers while running.

packages.name: smwsprites-harry-the-hedgehog
packages.title: Harry the Hedgehog
packages.description: A hedgehog similar to the one from SMW2:YI. When the player approaches, it sticks out its spines, rendering him immune to jump attacks. While it's wandering around, though, it can be stomped normally.

packages.name: smwsprites-homing-fishin-boo
packages.title: Homing Fishin' Boo
packages.description:
This is a Fishin' Boo that chases the player both vertically and horizontally.

Requested by TheKazooBloccGosh during Winter C3 2023.

packages.name: smwsprites-homing-horizontal-thwomp
packages.title: Homing Horizontal Thwomp
packages.description: A horizontal thwomp that tracks the player.

packages.name: smwsprites-homing-magikoopa
packages.title: Homing Magikoopa
packages.description:
A Magikoopa that shoots magic that homes in on you.
Can teleport around or be static.

Requested by Blizzard Buffalo.

packages.name: smwsprites-homing-thwomp-boss
packages.title: Homing Thwomp Boss
packages.description:
-Name of Sprite: Homing Thwomp
-Author: yoshicookiezeus
-Generator?: No
-Extra Bit Used?: No
-Sprite Graphics File?: Uses GFX03 in SP3 and GFX02 in SP4.
-Description: A custom Thwomp boss that follows Mario horizontally when on the ceiling, and falls when it gets close enough to him. It spawns Bob-ombs when it hits the floor, and is damaged by their explosions. It has three hit points and gets faster after each hit. See the enclosed readme for more information.

packages.name: smwsprites-homing-torpedo-ted
packages.title: Homing Torpedo Ted
packages.description:
A Torpedo Ted that will stop, point at the player's direction, charge forward and repeat. If the extra bit is set, it will explode after some time.

A launcher is included. Setting the extra bit to the launcher will transfer the explosive behavior to the launched sprite.

Make sure to check the .asm files for various configurations.


Your first dynamic sprite? A few notes for you:
  • If not using SA-1, the Dynamic Sprites Patch is required.
  • The Torpedo Ted's graphics are uploaded dynamically, so ExGFX is not required. The enclosed file is only to match the launcher hand with the explosion star, both not dynamic.
  • Nevertheless, dynamic sprites take up the lower half of SP4, so you should not use sprites that take graphics from that region unless you remap them.

packages.name: smwsprites-honen
packages.title: Honen
packages.description:
A bony fish that jumps from water and stays behind layers. It can be stomped. Don't forget to enable sprite buoyancy for your level if using this sprite.

This sprite was part of smkdan's Super Mario Land sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

packages.name: smwsprites-hoopster
packages.title: Hoopster
packages.description:
The ladybug from SMB2. It climbs on vines back and forth, is rideable and can be carried. It also gets faster when the player approaches.

This sprite was part of Romi's Sprite Package, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

packages.name: smwsprites-hopping-flame
packages.title: Hopping Flame
packages.description:
This is the original hopping flame from SMW.
BUT!
If the extra bit is set, the flame KEEPS stalking Mario, instead of having a 25% chance to jump to Mario's direction! To be assembled with PIXI

10/4/2022
-Now Sa-1 hybrid.
-GFX is no longer fixed to facing 1 direction.

packages.name: smwsprites-hoppycat
packages.title: Hoppycat
packages.description:
A spiky enemy that will hop when the player jumps.

If the extra bit is clear, it will stay in place, waiting for the player to come close to start hopping. If the extra bit is set, it will instead walk around and occasionally turn towards the player.

The enclosed graphics are by Lmda, so make sure to credit them if used!

packages.name: smwsprites-horizontal-boo-stream-vertical-wave-movement
packages.title: Horizontal Boo Stream, vertical wave movement
packages.description:
It's a Boo Steam that moves left/right with Up/Down Wave motion.
On Extra Bit Set it'll initially start moving up, otherwise it initially moves downwards.
Credit is optional.

versions.title: Horizontal Boo Stream, vertical wave movement

packages.name: smwsprites-horizontal-level-wrap
packages.title: Horizontal Level Wrap
packages.description:
Similar to the Vertical Level Wrap, except instead of connecting the left and right sides of the screen, it connects the top and bottom. Same as the one in the patches section, except it is a sprite for easy insert into different levels. It also fixes a bug that caused Mario to act kinda choppy when he was big.
No credit necessary.

packages.name: smwsprites-hot-foot
packages.title: Hot Foot
packages.description: A Hot Foot from SMB3 (the walking candle flame that follows you like the boos do).

packages.name: smwsprites-hot-lipped-blargg
packages.title: Hot-Lipped Blargg
packages.description: A dangerous Blargg that spits fire. Based upon original dissasembly by yoshicookiezeus. Graphics made by Wuffalo.

packages.name: smwsprites-huck-it-crab
packages.title: Huck-it Crab
packages.description: Remember that one little crab in New Super Mario Bros. Wii? Well, it's him! It throws a rock to the left, and then jumps backwards to the right. This is dynamic, so remember that you must patch dsx.asm in the patches section.

packages.name: smwsprites-hurt-death-block
packages.title: Hurt/Death Block
packages.description:
A sprite that can hurt/kill the player.
Requested by Gulaschko

packages.name: smwsprites-hybrid-big-boo-boss
packages.title: Hybrid Big Boo Boss
packages.description:
This is a hybrid between Big Boo and Big Boo Boss. It'll chase the player like regular boo, and can be defeated like a boss variant.

Requested by Beefy Chud.

packages.name: smwsprites-ice-bro
packages.title: Ice Bro
packages.description:
An Ice Bro. It walks back and forth, occasionally hopping and periodically throwing two iceballs, which will disappear when they hit the ground. They will freeze and hurt Mario (both can be turned off independently of each other).

It throws an extended sprite iceball. The included ExtendedGetDrawInfo fixes a crash in PIXI's, so it is highly recommended you replace it with it. You have to put ExtendedBlockInteraction is the routines folder for the sprite to assemble.

Make sure to specify the extended sprite number of the iceball (extended/iceball.asm) from list.txt in the Ice Bro's ASM file (sprites/IceBro.asm)!

packages.name: smwsprites-iggy-boss
packages.title: Iggy Boss 2024 Edition
packages.description:
This is an Iggy Boss which can be defeated with 5 hits which will deffert
when Iggy is hit, he will be an a Shell
on the third and fourth hit Iggy will Spit out a Fireball from the Bowser Statue Sprite
on Extra Bit 3 Iggy will throw hammers on the third and fourth hit
Requested by SMW Magic

2026/03/23
Fixed a bug where performing a finishing blow in the air would cause a soft lock.

packages.name: smwsprites-iggy-koopa
packages.title: Iggy Koopa
packages.description:
An Iggy Koopa boss which resembles the one in NSMBU. He walks between the left and right sides of the arena, occasionally spawning energy bolts, which chase Mario and disappear after a short amount of time. He can also walk on the ceiling. Mario can jump on him to damage him, after which he'll hide in his shell and chase Mario until he hits a wall, after which he'll go on the ceiling.

After 3 hits, he can also shoot fire while on the ceiling. By default, he dies after 5 hits. After Mario lands the finishing blow, he'll wait a bit before slamming into a wall and dying. If the extra bit is set, the level will be completed.

Make sure to specify the sprite number of the bolt from list.txt in iggy_koopa.asm! Check the ASM files for customization options.

Included graphics created by NO Body The Dragon.

packages.name: smwsprites-igniting-line-guided-rope
packages.title: Igniting Line-Guided Rope
packages.description:
This Line-Guided Rope overheats and burns after a while.

Requested by E-man38 during Winter C3 2024.

packages.name: smwsprites-invincible-flashing-shell
packages.title: Invincible/Flashing Shell
packages.description:
Like the shells when Yellow Shellless Koopa's jump into shells, but turns into a flashing shell instantly. It's invincible to stomps like the original, follows the player, etc. It also can be eaten by Yoshi, and gives him the ability to fly and ground pound, not to mention the fire ability when spit out.
No credit needed, PM me if you encounter any major glitches with this sprite.

(Rykon-V73): Added .json file for the sprite.

packages.name: smwsprites-invincible-shellboard
packages.title: Invincible Shellboard
packages.description:
A fliped disco shell(board) that you can ride (...Or can just get "pushed" by it depend method because why not? :P) and you can get nice X-speed boost jump when you take off from the shell(board) depends it's kicked speed. ("Kicked speed = Player's X-speed", when you interact with it basically.)

You cannot stop it normally once you kicked, except some cases...
Also, It never "die" from stuffs in normal ways either. (Again, exception exists too... Like "Sprite kill block" and lava etc.)

Based upon "Koopas + Shells + Disco Shell" by KevinM heavily, so please give big credits to him! :)

And special thanks to JamesD28 for give tips about kill/ride routines!
Without his help, I would still really struggle with about both routines no doubt. :D

Also, certains some customizable options too! (Check asm file for more info.)

(Pretty much required to patch "Player X Speed Fix" or something like that if you want full advantage of X-speed boost when you take off from kicked shell properly. It is due to one glitch that make you not able to jump properly at all when your X-speed exceeds on "certain" point.)

[Update log]
v1.1: Fixed small quirk when you trying to cape spin on the shell(board) if "!SpinBoostTimer = $00".
v1.11: Added "!InterruptNoInteractTime" option which let you set the timer for disable contact on player when shell(board) got interrupt by anything.
v1.2 : Rewrote ride routine completely so riding is now way more less janky now.
(Also, added some minor visual effect. :P)
v1.21 : Merged old/new method into one file, and added two options about insta-glide from shell(board). (Also fixed cape interaction stuffs too!)
v1.22 : Fixed a bit more so you can ride on shell(board) properly during goal sequence after touched goal tape/orb. (Only applied if "!RidingMethod" value is 0, which is default now.)
v1.3 : Revised "!RidingMethod = 1" to something more interesting than before... Check out! :) (Special thanks to JamesD28 for help me figure this properly.)

packages.name: smwsprites-invisible-boo
packages.title: Invisible Boo
packages.description:
This Boo stays invisible untill it's close enough to the player.

Credit is optional.

packages.name: smwsprites-invisible-coin
packages.title: Invisible Coin
packages.description:
This is an invisible sprite which spawns a set amount of coins when Mario touches it.

A GIEPY version also is included.

packages.name: smwsprites-invisible-mushroom
packages.title: Invisible Mushroom
packages.description:
Nearly identical to the original sprite. If Mario touches this sprite, it creates a Mushroom that flies into the air.

No credit needed.

packages.name: smwsprites-invisible-solid-block
packages.title: Invisible Solid Block
packages.description: This is a disassembly of sprite 6D in SMW, the invisible solid block.

packages.name: smwsprites-invisible-sprite
packages.title: Invisible Sprite
packages.description:
This is basically the invisible mushroom sprite, only it, well, isn't limited to a mushroom. You can make it spawn a normal or custom sprite, or even five sprites at once. Based off of Sonikku's invisible mushroom disassembly, although this one has about 3-4 times more code than the original did.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

packages.name: smwsprites-invisible-sprite-killer-box-v1
packages.title: Invisible Sprite Killer Box v1.1
packages.description:
This invisible sprite will kill any other standard sprite it comes into contact with, even ones that are not meant to interact with objects or other sprites.

Version v1.1 by Darolac

-Converted to PIXI.
-Added the option to kill sprites on the same line of the sprite.
-Optimized the code.

Old GIEPY version is still included.

packages.name: smwsprites-invisible-warp-hole-blocks
packages.title: Invisible Warp Hole Blocks
packages.description: A disassembly of sprite 8E. It warps Mario to the right of it when he touches it. Dunno what it would be useful for, but hey, its here for everyone wanting it. No credit needed.

packages.name: smwsprites-joe-the-shark
packages.title: Joe the Shark
packages.description:
Joe the Shark and his pals are so hungry and mean that they will jump out of the ocean to attack Mario. Because Joe is so muscular, Mario can't stomp on him, and fireballs do not affect him. Joe wears boxing gloves, but he doesn't seem to use them against Mario.

This sprite was originally part of andy_k_250's Custom Tweaked Sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards. They were made as a demo of the ability for mikeyk's Spritetool (also inherited by PIXI) to create tweaked copies of vanilla sprites without altering the vanilla sprites themselves, via a .cfg file that does not reference an .asm file at all. Therefore, the lack of .asm files in this download is not only intentional, it is the main idea.

packages.name: smwsprites-jumpin-chuck
packages.title: Jumpin' Chuck
packages.description:
A modified Chuck which periodically jumps in a jumping pattern like a Ninji.

Requested by sholmes.

packages.name: smwsprites-jumpin-goomba
packages.title: Jumpin' Goomba
packages.description: A Goomba that jumps. It follows Mario and jumps higher if the extra bit is set, you can easily customize the jump height in the .asm file.

packages.name: smwsprites-jumping-piranha-plant-plus
packages.title: Jumping Piranha Plant Plus
packages.description:
This is a pack with of piranha plants which can go in 4 directions with various options that can be set with the extra bytes/bits.
Extra bit - spit fireballs if set
Extra byte 1 - sets piranha color and the type of piranha
Extra byte 2 - delay for the first jump of the piranha
Extra byte 3 - speed with which the piranha jumps
Note: In the update i added new options, added some comments as well as made the piranha behaviour more accurate to the original ones.

packages.name: smwsprites-jumping-piranha-plants
packages.title: Jumping Piranha Plants
packages.description: This is a disassembly of sprites 4F and 50 in SMW, the jumping Piranha Plants.  The extra bit determines which of the original sprites it acts like.

packages.name: smwsprites-jumping-spike-ball
packages.title: Jumping Spike Ball
packages.description:
This is a fusion between the Surface Jumping Fish and the Floating Spike Ball, the result being a Jumping Spike Ball! It behaves similarly to the vanilla spike ball, but it jumps. Extra Bit sets its horizontal speed.

To be inserted with PIXI. Supports SA-1 as well. Make note that sprite buoyancy is needed for this sprite to work properly, similarly to the surface jumping fish.

packages.name: smwsprites-jumpy-grinder
packages.title: Jumpy Grinder
packages.description:
This is very simple: It's a constantly jumping grinder. Height is customizable. Don't credit me, credit Iceguy for the awesome dissasembly. (you can credit me if you want :3)

Mod edit: Don't make it able to reach a ceiling, since it will pass through it!

packages.name: smwsprites-kabomb
packages.title: Kabomb
packages.description:
A kabomb, inspired by NSMB's kabomb. It walks around and, when it comes in contact with some selected sprites, it'll turn red and chase the player. The sprites it can come in contact with can be customized, and it's possible to use normal, extended and cluster sprites, and both normal and custom sprites. See README.txt for details.

Graphics made by Epic_Stuff, credit him/her too!

packages.name: smwsprites-kaboomba
packages.title: Kaboomba
packages.description:
This is a Kaboomba enemy from Yoshi's Island that was initially designed for Super Mario World Prototype. This walking cannon periodically shoots sprites. It can be stood on but hurts from sides.

Credit is optional.

packages.name: smwsprites-kabu
packages.title: Kabu
packages.description:
The Kabu from Kirby, a 16x16 sprite which will either jump back and forth or slide on the ground, depending on its extra bit. Mario can kill it by jumping on it.

Originally part of the Kirby Sprite Pack.

packages.name: smwsprites-kaizo-seed
packages.title: Kaizo Seed
packages.description:
A muncher, falling down to the bottom.
While in air, it's not dangerous and gets pushed up by Mario, if touched.
When it touches the bottom, it turns into a regular muncher.

My first submitted Sprite, so yay and stuff.

packages.name: smwsprites-key
packages.title: Key
packages.description:
This is a disassembly of sprite 80 in SMW - Key.
Requested by Hamtaro126.

Update: Made use of new print statements to make the disassembly more accurate.

packages.name: smwsprites-keyhole
packages.title: Keyhole
packages.description:
The keyhole from SMW, disassembled and commented.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

packages.name: smwsprites-kirby-boss
packages.title: Kirby Boss
packages.description:
A Kirby boss. It will move between the left and right edges of the screen in various different ways, such as walking or jumping. It can also shoot fire. Mario must jump on it to damage it. When it dies, it will fall down.

Check the ASM file for customization options.

packages.name: smwsprites-kirby-s-dream-land-waddle-doo
packages.title: Kirby's Dream Land - Waddle Doo
packages.description:
A Cyclops-like relative of the Waddle Dee from the Kirby series. It can jump around and shoot a beam in an arch. See the ASM file for more information.

Requested by Idunno.

packages.name: smwsprites-kirby-s-dreamland
packages.title: Kirby's Dreamland 3 Tick
packages.description: The tick, an enemy from Kirby's Dreamland 3. It starts off as an innocent 16x16 sprite. It will start walking towards Mario if he goes above it. When he's directly above it, it will extend its spike upwards. It can be defeated by any means other than jumping.

packages.name: smwsprites-koopa-shell-spawns-kicked
packages.title: Koopa Shell, spawns kicked
packages.description:
This will spawn a koopa shell in a kicked state. Requested by lolyoshi. Includes one cfg file for each shell color.
SA-1 compatible.

packages.name: smwsprites-koopas-shells-disco-shell
packages.title: Koopas + Shells + Disco Shell
packages.description:
This is a disassembly (+ some added features) of sprites 4-7, the normal Koopas, and DA-DF, the Shells (normal and Disco variant). It includes a lot of options that can be set either with the extra bytes or with the defines (check out the asm files for more info).
It's included a json file for each Koopa color that will set up a list of sprites in LM's menu with all the main variants (Koopa, stationary Shell with or without a Koopa inside, kicked Shell, Disco Shell).

packages.name: smwsprites-koopatrol
packages.title: Koopatrol
packages.description:
The Koopatrol from Paper Mario. It wanders around randomly. If Mario comes close enough, it will use one of two attacks - go in its shell and chase mario, or attempt to ram him. To kill him, you get him to ram into a wall, and then jump on him while he is on his back, or run into him with a Star.

NOTE: WILL NOT WORK WELL WITH SLOPES!

Graphics ripped by Leod. No credit needed; to be assembled with Romi's Sprite Tool JackTheSpades's PIXI.

packages.name: smwsprites-koophd
packages.title: KooPhD
packages.description:
This is the KooPhD sprite, originally coded by Kipernal for SMWCP II, coded by me completely from scratch with some more features. KooPhD.asm is the main sprite, while the potions he throws is vial.asm. Demonstration video: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bRPDkAvaJhc

Credit would be appreciated but isn't necessary.

MAJOR FLARE's UPDATE: PIXI and SA-1 Conversion. On request by Green.
BLIZZARD BUFFALO'S UPDATE: Added graphics.
THOMAS' UPDATE: Cleaned up unnecessary unmarked free RAM usage.

packages.name: smwsprites-kumo
packages.title: Kumo
packages.description:
A spider from Super Mario Land that jumps towards Mario every once in a while.

This sprite was part of smkdan's Super Mario Land sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

packages.name: smwsprites-kun-beta-sprite
packages.title: Kun (Beta Sprite)
packages.description:
This is an interpretation of the scrapped beta sprite known as "Kun" (one-chr-kun.OBJ) from the July 2020 SMW gigaleak. This odd little creature can either move back and forth, or follow ground, walls and ceilings like a Spike Top, and when touched, can disappear in a puff of smoke and knock the player back. It can also hurt the player when touched, or not interact at all and act as a little background buddy.

See the .asm file for usage notes and customization options.

Overwrites four 8x8 tiles (the Note Block bounce sprite by default) in SP3.

Requested by RollingRigatonis.

---

Edited during moderation to allow the hurt variety to knock Mario off Yoshi instead of hurting him.

packages.name: smwsprites-lakitu-s-cloud-no-time-limit
packages.title: Lakitu's cloud (No time limit)
packages.description: A disassembly of sprite 87 in SMW, Lakitu's cloud.

packages.name: smwsprites-lantern
packages.title: Lantern
packages.description:
When this sprite spawns, it will decrease the screen brightness to a configurable amount. When it's shot by a fireball (Mario's or Yoshi's), it will light up for a short amount of time. If the extra bit is set, it will never go out.

Check the ASM file for configuration options.

Based on the lanterns in Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past. Demonstration video.

packages.name: smwsprites-larry-boss
packages.title: Larry Boss
packages.description:
This boss will walk around the arena, periodically throwing one of three types of fireballs: green, red, or blue. He gets faster after every hit and dies after (by default) 5 hits.

The green fireballs turn into a Galoomba when they hit a wall. The Galoomba can be used to hurt the boss. The red fireballs disappear when they hit a wall. Both of the two hurt Mario and can be configured to turn into any sprite, normal or custom. The blue fireballs disappear when they hit a wall and freeze Mario for a short time if he touches them.

Make sure to specify the sprite numbers of the fireballs in larry.asm! Check the ASM files for customization options. If you give Larry more than 5 HP, make sure to expand the horizontal speed table.

packages.name: smwsprites-laser-from-quick-man-s-stage
packages.title: Laser from Quick Man's stage
packages.description:
A laser as annoying as the ones in Quick Man's stage. Has 4 configurable directions, and it can play a sound effect.

Note that this works by spawning a custom map16 tile: if it were merely sprites it'd be overkill. Because of that, don't put a lot of them in a single screen or you'll get black bars at the top.

packages.name: smwsprites-lava-lotus
packages.title: Lava Lotus
packages.description:
This is a port of the Lava Lotus from SMB3. Found in underwater levels, this sprite shoots 5 fireballs upward, which fizzle out shortly afterward.

If the Extra Bit is set, it'll be upside down and cling to ceilings.

See the main LavaLotus.asm file for remapping/configuration changes.

Version History:
- 1/25/2025: v1.00 / Initial release.
- 1/25/2025: v1.01 / Added upside-down variant as an Extra Bit setting.
- 1/25/2025: v1.02 / Setting the Extra Byte will now offset the sprite by 8 pixels to be centered the same as it is in SMB3.
- 1/25/2025: v1.1 / Added a setting to spawn the fireballs as cluster sprites instead of extended. Fixed minor clipping issues with projectile.

packages.name: smwsprites-lava-lotus-pack
packages.title: Lava Lotus Pack
packages.description: A pack of Lava Lotuses, including the one from SMB3 and additional types of lotus. It includes a Changing Lotus, Hungry Lotus, Spawning Lotus and a custom spore projectile.

packages.name: smwsprites-layer
packages.title: Layer 3 Candle Flames
packages.description:
This sprite will spawn custom candle flames that can be used with layer 3 background, like the one found here.

Requested by Hayashi Neru.

packages.name: smwsprites-leaf-shield-carol-style
packages.title: Leaf Shield, carol-style
packages.description:
A Leaf Shield powerup from Mega Man 2. Follows Mario's location, then when pressing R, spawns the actual shield. Press R again to fire it at enemies. Based on code by carol from Brutal Mario, but re-coded by myself.

Possibly fun as a one stage gimmick but can be overpowered, so use sparingly.

Please have fun with it!

Uses the greens in Palette B so please be cautious if you're using a custom palette!

UPDATE (13/03/2020): Clears the "disappear while $9D is set" bug. Now you can grab mushrooms, get hit and die without the shield vanishing temporarily. Also fixed a bug where the launch sprite didn't follow you around, making it so that if you tried to spawn the Leaf Shield after it despawned (as it, again, doesn't follow you around) nothing would happen.

packages.name: smwsprites-ledge-dwelling-any-sprite
packages.title: Ledge-Dwelling Any Sprite
packages.description:
This sprites allows you to spawn a vanilla or custom sprite from a ledge, similar to the ledge-dwelling Monty Mole.
Note that this spawner works best with vanilla or custom sprites which have gravity.

Requested by Metro Shroomin during C3 Winter 2025.

packages.name: smwsprites-ledge-dwelling-mega-mole
packages.title: Ledge-Dwelling Mega Mole
packages.description: A mega mole that spawns a-la ledge-dwelling monty mole.

packages.name: smwsprites-lemmy-s-circus-ball
packages.title: Lemmy's Circus Ball
packages.description:
A ball that bounces around like a football. It will make Mario bounce if he collides with it, kind of like a Bumpty.
Requested by chineesmw.

packages.name: smwsprites-lemmy-wendy
packages.title: Lemmy/Wendy
packages.description:
This boss will walk back and forth, occasionally spawning a projectile. Depending on the extra bit, it will behave like a custom Lemmy or a custom Wendy. By default, it takes 5 hits to kill. It can activate a switch in the middle of the fight.

Lemmy will either spawn a ball which will break on hitting a wall, or a ball which can be picked up and thrown at him to damage him.

Wendy will either spawn rings which will disappear on hitting a wall, or a rideable egg which can be picked up and thrown at her to damage her.

Make sure to specify the sprite numbers of the balls, the ring, and the egg in lemmy_wendy.asm! Check the ASM files for customization options.

packages.name: smwsprites-lemon-drop
packages.title: Lemon Drop
packages.description:
This is the Lemon Drop from Yoshi's Island, that little yellow slime thing found in one room of 3-4 and used to create the 1-8 boss. It can be made to spawn a single sprite or spawn additional ones like a generator (see the .asm file for more details).

*NOTE: The version that generates additional Lemon Drops may cause lag; it is best used in a place that doesn't have too many other sprites to process. Don't use it anywhere where there could be no valid ceiling for the new slimes to spawn on either, or it will freeze the game.

packages.name: smwsprites-level-ender-v1
packages.title: Level Ender v1.1
packages.description:
This sprite will cause the level to end when all the enemies on screen are killed. This version ignores sprites that don't turn into a coin when the goal tape is passed.

Uses extra bit: YES
When the extra bit is clear, the sprite will trigger the regular exit. When it is set, the sprite will trigger the secret exit.

Read the readme if you want to use secret exit + no walk config.

Extra property byte 1: if 0, Mario will freeze when the level ends.

Extra property byte 2: it's the song number that plays at the level end. Change from C to 3 if using AddmusicK.

v1.1
-----
Added a readme about secret exits. They only work if you allow the player to walk. This is an in-game piece of code, if you wanna change this behaviour, read the readme.
Fixed a bug with setting up secret exits.

v1.0
-----
Tattletale - moved out of pixi.

packages.name: smwsprites-light-bug
packages.title: Light Bug
packages.description: When you touch this sprite it will die and the screen will get darker. Here is a video.

packages.name: smwsprites-light-switch
packages.title: Light Switch
packages.description:
This is the light switch from Bowser's castle, ported as a custom sprite and ready to be inserted and customized.

This only works when sprite $C6 (dark room sprite) is in the room, but you can easily disable that.

packages.name: smwsprites-line-guided-any-sprite-v1
packages.title: Line-Guided Any Sprite v1.3
packages.description:
This sprite acts as a wrapper for any normal or custom sprite*, allowing it to easily be made line-guided at the cost of an extra sprite slot.
Check out the asm file for info on how to use it.

Original sprite by dtothefourth, I optimized it a bit and made some fixes:
- Now it works properly with Yoshi and with carryable sprites.
- Now it works properly when Yoshi or Baby Yoshi eat the sprite.
- Now the sprite won't respawn when the wrapped sprite is killed or collected (e.g. sprite killed with a spin jump, collected powerup).
- Now compatible with Line Guide Acts-Like fix.

v1.1 update:
- Small code optimizations.
- Added an option in the 4th extra byte to be used with platforms: if set, Mario will move with the platform instead of sliding on it (like normal line-guided platforms do).
- Now the sprite uses 8 extra bytes: the last 4 set the 4 extra bytes for the spawned sprite.

v1.2 update:
- Fixed a bug where if the wrapped sprite failed to spawn (due to sprite slots being full) the wrapper would be erased forever, instead of being able to respawn (thanks to MarioFanGamer for pointing this out).
- Added a second platform option, to make it compatible with sprites that use custom platform code (for example, this) (thanks to MarioFanGamer for suggesting this).
- Now the sprite uses 9 extra bytes: the 5th one sets the speed multiplier for the sprite (if you want to make it move faster).
- Fixed an issue where the sprite would despawn immediately after spawning when using a non-zero offset and spawning it from a specific direction.

v1.3 update:
- Fixed bug where on spawn this sprite could cause an unrelated sprite to teleport to its location (thanks mellonpizza for finding the fix)

*Some sprites may not work properly, for example Rotating Platform and Ball n' Chain.

packages.name: smwsprites-line-guided-colored-blocks-switch-toggled
packages.title: Line Guided Colored Blocks, Switch Toggled
packages.description:
A line guided 3-block platform that can have various colors. The platform can be in an inactive state, in which it doesn't move, and in an active state, in which, naturally, it moves.

With the extra bit set, this sprite becomes a switch which will toggle every existing platform's state. The switch can also have multiple colors and will only act upon platforms that match its color.

Inspired by a similar entity in Super Mario Bros. X.

versions.title: Line Guided Colored Blocks, Switch Toggled

packages.title: Lololo and Lalala
packages.description:
This is a close approximation of Lololo and Lalala from the Kirby universe.

The sprite does not end the level by itself.

Check the ASM files for customization options. Make to read the included readme for information on setting up the sprite.

Included is Sonniku's Passable Ledge with SFX block, which is used for the fight. Special thanks to idol for fixing the sprite's graphics, as the original came with no palette.

packages.name: smwsprites-mario-bros-arcade-pow-block
packages.title: Mario Bros. Arcade POW Block
packages.description:
A POW meant to be used in conjunction with the other Mario Bros. Arcade sprites made by Sonikku. When smashed, it'll shake the screen and affect said sprites. If the extra bit is set, it'll be displaced 8 pixels to the right, useful if you want it centered in a specific screen.

packages.name: smwsprites-mario-bros-arcade-spiny
packages.title: Mario Bros. Arcade Spiny
packages.description:
A spiny that behaves like most sprites in the Mario Bros. arcade game. A hit will stun it for a short period, leaving it open for defeat. After this period it'll hop back up in a new color and move faster. If placed in the air, it'll be a Spiny egg. More info on behaviors and customization options are written in the ASM file.

This sprite was part of Sonikku's Mario Bros. (Arcade) sprite pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

packages.name: smwsprites-mario-bros-arcade-sprite-spawner
packages.title: Mario Bros. Arcade Sprite Spawner
packages.description:
A shooter meant to be used in conjunction with the other Mario Bros. Arcade sprites made by Sonikku. It'll shoot the sprites in random states either to the left or right depending on its X position.

This shooter was part of Sonikku's Mario Bros. (Arcade) sprite pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

packages.title: Mechakoopa but Awesome v1.0
packages.description:
This is based on the Mario Maker 2 take on the Mechakoopa. It comes in four variants:
- Green: the defualt one you're used to
- Red: shoots projectiles
- Blue: shoots lightning
- Yellow: explodes after being damaged
You choose color with the first extra byte. You can set the extra bit to enable the sprite to fly through the air using its jets.

packages.description: This door stops the screen from scrolling past it. But if the player touches it, the door will open, dragging the player and the screen to the other side and then closing. Useful if you want a "separate room screen" effect. Must be placed on a screen border or Mario will die when he walks through.

packages.name: smwsprites-megaman-spine

packages.description:
The Spine from Megaman, a little robot-spike-blade thingy that sits there and waits for Mario to walk on the same height as itself, and then gives chase.

I'm not sure how accurate this is to the Megaman original since I never saw it in action, but according to the person who requested it, it's good enough.


Graphics and palette included, instructions on how to adjust them at the top of the asm file.

Moderator's note: Indeed, it doesn't act like the original; the original sprite moved back and forth but sped up when the player was at the same horizontal position rather than being stationary until the player is both at the same horizontal position and on the ground. But it does at least seem to work.

packages.name: smwsprites-metroid-v1-0
packages.title: Metroid v1.0.2
packages.description:
This guy hovers lazily in the air until Mario approaches. Then it begins to chase him wildly. Should it catch Mario, it latches on and begins draining coins from him at an alarming rate (if he has any). To kill it once it latches on, repeatedly mash the controller buttons and you'll shake it off. It can optionally hurt or kill the player if they have no coins. It can also drain air meter.

The tilemap, amount of mashing needed for it to latch out, speeds and detection range are customizable. Check the ASM file for further information.

Give credit if used or tweaked.

BIG thank-you to smkdan for helping debug a serious problem while making this sprite.

packages.name: smwsprites-micro-paragoomba
packages.title: Micro-Paragoomba
packages.description:
Micro-Paragoomba is the name given to a species of small Goombas that can fly. They attack with a wave-like pattern. One stomp will ground them for good.

This sprite was originally part of andy_k_250's Custom Tweaked Sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards. They were made as a demo of the ability for mikeyk's Spritetool (also inherited by PIXI) to create tweaked copies of vanilla sprites without altering the vanilla sprites themselves, via a .cfg file that does not reference an .asm file at all. Therefore, the lack of .asm files in this download is not only intentional, it is the main idea.

packages.name: smwsprites-midway-point-v1
packages.title: Midway Point v1.1
packages.description:
This sprite is a sprite version of the midway point bar.
You can set this to be either 24x8 (a bar like the real block) and 16x16 (a full block).

TODO: Add multi midway point compatibility.

packages.name: smwsprites-mikeyk-s-sprite-clipping-test
packages.title: mikeyk's Sprite Clipping Test
packages.description:
This is an in-game tool consisting of a block and a sprite that provides a test environment which shows every sprite clipping size available in SMW. This is perfect for anyone who is coding a sprite, but doesn't know what clipping size to set in the .cfg file.

The coin counter will display the clipping value, and the sprite will show the size of the hitbox.

This was originally submitted as a tool, but it's better off being a sprite.

packages.name: smwsprites-milde
packages.title: Milde
packages.description:
The Milde enemy from Yoshi's Island.
It can be stomped causing the sprite to quickly smush down. The explosion that the sprite causes will function similarly to a cape spin (or Yoshi's Ground Pound ability) to nearby sprites. If the sprite affected is another Milde, they will get stunned and bounce a few times before recovering.

Both Milde variants stay on ledges, akin to Red Koopas.
When a Big Milde is defeated, it will spawn four normal Mildes. These Mildes must be defeated before the Big Milde can be considered defeated -- if Mario allows a single Milde to despawn without being defeated, the Big Milde will be able to respawn when Mario leaves and returns to the area.

NOTE: It is recommended you use the No More Sprite Tile Limits patch. Failure to do so may cause flickering when several of them are on-screen or when the explosion animation displays.

Changelog:
07-10-2020:
-- Initial release.
02-12-2022:
-- Rewrote Milde graphics routine to correct some display issues.
-- Updated collision with Mario to utilize a generic macro for detecting a stomp, rather than relying on SubVertPos.
-- Updated collision to account for Yoshi when stomping the sprite and when touching the sprite from the side.
-- Added a few settings.
-- Updated existing settings to use "if" statements instead of reading from a define in the sprite code.
-- Updated JSON file so sprite appears in Lunar Magic properly

packages.name: smwsprites-minecart

If the extra bit is set, it will eat any tile, and if it isn't, encountering a solid tile will make it disappear. Best used in levels where the walls are made up of one-tile-high bricks, to avoid cutoffness.

**NOTE: Don't use in conjunction with slopes, Layer 2 levels, or vertical levels!

packages.description:
This is the vulture from the Donkey Kong games. It flies up and down and can be defeated by any means. Occasionally, it shoots nuts. It always faces Mario.

If the extra bit is clear, it will shoot one nut, which will slowly go in a straight line. If the extra bit is set, it will shoot three fast nuts in a spreadshot type of fashion.

Make sure to specify the sprite number of the nut in mini_necky.asm! Check the ASM files for customization options.

packages.name: smwsprites-mini-torpedo-ted

Can be used with custom torpedo launcher.

packages.name: smwsprites-missile-bill-pack
packages.title: Missile Bill Pack
packages.description:
Missile Bills that follow Mario horizontally or vertically and will make a single or unlimited turns if the extra bits are set. Comes with frost versions.

(Update 2022-09-24: Fixed a missing SA-1 compatibility --Fernap)

packages.name: smwsprites-mister-bouncy
packages.title: Mister Bouncy
packages.description:
This simple sprite hurts Mario if he touches it from the sides, but if he tries to jump on it, he will be bounced without harming the sprite.

Based on mikeyk's Shyguy code, so is configurable with koopa settings such as walk fast, stay on ledges, follow Mario, jump over shells, and spinkill enabled.

packages.name: smwsprites-molotov-bro
packages.title: Molotov Bro.
packages.description: This guy throws molotov bombs at mario. The molotov bomb turns to fire when it touches the ground.

packages.name: smwsprites-moneybags
packages.title: Moneybags
packages.description:
This is a recreation of the Moneybags enemy originally found in Super Mario 64, and later seen in New Super Mario Bros. The Moneybags will look like a coin and remain stationary, but once the player gets too close, it will reveal it's true form and start bouncing away from or towards the player. When defeated, Moneybags will disappear in a puff of smoke and award coins (either directly or by spawning coin sprites).

There are a lot of customization options. See the .asm file for all features, details of the extra byte usage and defines.

Includes a custom version of the Moving Coin sprite (the vanilla uses hardcoded speeds). Also contains graphics which replace the Flyin' Hammer Brother in SP3.

Requested by Black Goku.

packages.name: smwsprites-monty-mole-pile
packages.title: Monty Mole Pile
packages.description: This pile will continiously produce monty moles. Originally made for Hackjam.

packages.name: smwsprites-morton-boss
packages.title: Morton Boss
packages.description:
A 48x48 boss which moves between the left and right edges of the screen. It can shoot bullets and it will get faster after each hit. By default, it takes 5 hits to kill it. It can display its HP on the status bar.

Check the ASM file for customization options.

Give credit to me.

Tester's Note: Sprite palette 4 (also included as a palette file) gives Morton his correct colors. The boss is very easy to defeat by itself.

packages.name: smwsprites-mosaic-thwimp

packages.description:
Thwimp that goes right/left or up/down until it hits a wall, and then turns around.

Customizable with the defines.

I submitted this because "I might as well". It's a pretty simple sprite, but it may be useful for level design.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

packages.name: smwsprites-mother-dino-rhino-dino-torch-egg
packages.title: Mother Dino Rhino + Dino Torch Egg

A Dino Rhino that occasionally lays eggs with Dino Torches inside. The eggs will hatch immediately.

If the extra bit is set, this sprite is instead an independent Dino Torch egg. It will hatch when the player is in close proximity, like baby Yoshi eggs.

The .asm file features many customisation options, including changing which sprite hatches out of the egg and even which sprite the Dino Rhino becomes when stomped.

When the extra bit is set, the fireball will face the player's direction and move towards him accordingly.

packages.name: smwsprites-moving-brown-platform

This is a simple platform that moves back and forth horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Based off of Mirumo's SMB3 Brown Platform code.

Now PIXI compatible.

packages.description:
A disassembly of sprite 21, the moving coin.

It can be set to act like the normal coin or a silver one (which increments the number of points given with each coin collected).

packages.name: smwsprites-moving-ledge-hole-v1

The moving ledge hole sprite seen in SMW ghost houses, disassembled and commented.

- Fixed "act as" in the CFG file.
- Added fix from LM 2.53+ that prevents the sprite from teleporting one screen down when placed on a vertical screen boundary.

packages.name: smwsprites-moving-midway-point-tape
packages.title: Moving Midway Point Tape
packages.description:
It's like a goal tape, but a midway point tape instead. It automatically detects the height of the pole as long as the "Act as" settings of the left pole are correct (2F-31) so you can place it comfortably. Extra Byte 1 determines its speed.

When collected, the tape will give some points. The higher the tape is hit, the higher the score. If the tape is hit at the highest possible spot, which is frame perfect, a 1-up will be given. These features can optionally be disabled.

Not compatible with any multiple midway point patches yet, sorry!

packages.name: smwsprites-moving-platform-with-firebar
packages.title: Moving Platform with Firebar
packages.description:
You can create lifts that go back and forth between certain sections and lifts that keep moving in one direction when you get on them.
In the case of going back and forth over a fixed section, the problem of the lift not returning to its original position after exiting the screen has also been fix.

The following settings are available
- Common -
Setting the direction of movement (8 directions)
Platform Size (4 levels)
Firebar presence
Firebar size
Direction of firebar rotation
Rotation speed of the firebar

- Going back and forth between fixed sections -
Maximum speed travel time setting (32 steps)
Maximum speed setting (4 steps)
Setting of acceleration (normal or x2)
Setting of numbers (none, 1-7 Only one per number works at the same time)
Shift of initial position according to travel distance and direction

- Movement in one direction -
Setting of moving speed (4 levels)
Whether it disappears if not ridden for a certain period of time

-Update-
-A few explanatory notes in the asm file have been added.
-In Lunar Magic, the direction of movement of the lift is now displayed. It is also drawn as a Checker platform, just as it is in the game.
-A problem with one of the double firebars being slightly shifted by the initial position shift has been corrected.

packages.name: smwsprites-mr-saturn

packages.description:
Mr. Saturn walks peacefully. If grabbed, he can be thrown at enemies, destroying them relentlessly.

packages.name: smwsprites-multi-bounce-shell-v1
packages.title: Multi-Bounce Shell v1.1
packages.description:
A simple shell that can be bounced multiple times with a counter showing how many bounces are left.

- Number of bounces from 1 to 9 or infinite;

- Will destroy itself after the last bounce;

- If extra bit is set it will spawn in kicked state going towards the player direction;

- Uses custom exgfx tile for the numbers and "infinite" symbol (just a slightly modified GFX20.bin file. SP4 of Banzai Bill tileset). Should be renamed before inserting. Remap it to fit your needs.

Update (KevinM):
- Added 5-9 bounces option (and updated GFX file with those tiles)
- Changed bounce number define to use the first extra byte instead: no need to insert the same sprite multiple times
- Changed initial kicked speed define to use the second extra byte instead
- Changed cfg file to json with Lunar Magic custom sprite list entries for the different options
- Added json files for different palettes as well (Green, Red, Yellow, Blue)

packages.name: smwsprites-multiple-rotating-sprites-spawner
packages.title: Multiple Rotating Sprites Spawner
packages.description:
This sprite acts similarly as vanilla sprite E0 (triple rotating platforms) but with many more options for the spawned sprites, customizable with the extra bytes, including:
- Amount of sprites (between 1 and 8)
- For each one, if it is a Ball n' Chain or a Platform
- For each one, if it shouldn't be spawned (if you want to leave "holes" in the circle or to have less sprites rotating closer together).
The rotation direction depends on the X position like in vanilla, unless you're using the Sprite Properties Depending on the Extra Bit patch, in which case it will depend on the extra bit.
Included in the json file are some example sprites you can find in the custom sprite list in LM. See the asm file or the LM tooltip for more info on how the options work.

packages.name: smwsprites-muncher-bridge
packages.title: Muncher Bridge
packages.description:
This is a turn block bridge, except with munchers instead of blocks. So it hurts.
Make sure to check out the asm file for customization options.
Requested by Romano338.

packages.name: smwsprites-needle-bird
packages.title: Needle Bird
packages.description: This sprite is inspired from Seiken Densetsu 3. Basically, it flies back and forth horizontally, and when Mario is near, spit three balls at him.

packages.name: smwsprites-needle-spitting-urchin
packages.title: Needle-spitting Urchin
packages.description:
This Urchin is static, but spits needles at the player. The first extra byte controls the timer, the second controls the pattern type, and the third controls the direction. Patterns include horizontal only, vertical only, both, or a tracking needle.

The needle has a poison feature, which requires UberASMTool.

packages.name: smwsprites-net-dry-bones
packages.title: Net Dry Bones
packages.description:
Based on the Net Koopa dissasembly by imamelia, this Dry Bones acts like a Net Koopa; however, jumping on him will make him crumble and act like a normal Dry Bones. The generated Dry Bones will stay behind nets if the Net Dry Bones is jumped on behind the net. This sprite requires a patch that is included in the .zip.

Graphics made by Wuffalo.

packages.name: smwsprites-net-koopas
packages.title: Net Koopas
packages.description:
This is a disassembly of sprites 22-25 in SMW, the net Koopas. They have more options than would fit within a single .cfg file (horizontal/vertical, green/red, above/below the net), so I included two.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

packages.name: smwsprites-net-sparky-fuzzy
packages.title: Net Sparky/Fuzzy
packages.description:
This Sparky/Fuzzball is different from these from SMW because instead of following walls or line-guides, they instead stay on top of nets. Read the readme and ASM file for more information.

Requested by gohkenytp8.

packages.name: smwsprites-new-super-mario-bros-spiked-question-mark-block
packages.title: New Super Mario Bros - Spiked Question Mark Block
packages.description:
This is a spiked question mark block, a block which rotates itself while one side is spiked. It's non-dynamic so it can only turn in four directions but it is easier to insert and more than four can be on-screen as well. The content can be filled in various ways.

Credits is required.

Requested by Ice Man.

versions.title: New Super Mario Bros - Spiked Question Mark Block

packages.name: smwsprites-new-super-mario-bros-spin-block
packages.title: New Super Mario Bros - Spin Block
packages.description:
This is a Super Mario World themed recreation of the Spin Block from New Super Mario Bros, typically seen in "Athletic" levels. When Mario stands on the platform, it will rev up and start spinning Mario. Pressing B will make him jump off the platform normally, but pressing A will launch him into the sky with a spin-float ability. You can then let Mario slowly float back down, or make him dive down fast by pressing down. When diving, Mario can break through turnblocks.

Requires DSX (already applied by default if you're using SA-1).

versions.title: New Super Mario Bros - Spin Block

packages.name: smwsprites-new-super-mario-bros-stretch-shroom
packages.title: New Super Mario Bros. - Stretch Shroom
packages.description: A mushroom platform which expands and contracts over a certain period of time. When on top, the player moves along with it.

versions.title: New Super Mario Bros. - Stretch Shroom

packages.name: smwsprites-new-timed-lifts
packages.title: New Timed Lifts
packages.description:
These are some more Timed Lifts based off of Davros's. I have included three types:

-Expanded: These are exactly like normal Timed Lifts, only they have 5-9 seconds on them instead of 1-4.

-Manual: These can be controlled with the controller buttons.

-Bomber: These can also be controlled with the controller buttons, but when you press the Y button, they drop bombs. The number on the platform, in this case, is an ammo counter instead of a timer. When it drops to 0, you can't move it and it won't drop any more bombs.

Now SA-1 compatible.

packages.name: smwsprites-ninji
packages.title: Ninji
packages.description: This is a disassembly of sprite 51 in SMW, the Ninji.

packages.name: smwsprites-ninji-jumps-with-player
packages.title: Ninji, Jumps With Player
packages.description:
This ninji will jump when the player also jumps.
Credit is optional.

packages.name: smwsprites-nipper-hungry-nipper
packages.title: Nipper + Hungry Nipper
packages.description: A Nipper and Hungry Nipper from Romi's Sprite Tool, converted and ready to be inserted with PIXI.

versions.title: Nipper + Hungry Nipper
versions.filename: Mikeyk%27s Nipper + Hungry Nipper for PIXI.zip

packages.name: smwsprites-nitro-crate-v1
packages.title: Nitro Crate v1.0
packages.description:
I decided to create the Nitro Crate from Crash Bandicoot. Even more, I wanted to share it on this site!

Anyway, below is the description.

The Nitrous Crate is a sprite that will explode when it is touched. There are a few minor issues that can be easily worked around.

#1: The Nitro Crate sprite uses SP1, however... it's blast uses SP4. So, SP's = SP1= ExGFXxx SP4= GFX02 or ExGFXxx

#2: It will only explode if Mario touches, not when a koopa does.

#3: It doesn't hop... yet.

Please give credit if used.

Now SA-1 compatible.

packages.name: smwsprites-non-boss-homing-thwomp
packages.title: Non-Boss Homing Thwomp
packages.description: Much like the boss version, this Thwomp follows Mario horizontally when on the ceiling, and falls whenever it gets close to him. However, this version doesn't spawn Bob-Ombs, is completely invulnerable, and is perfectly compatible with levels of more than one screen's length.

packages.name: smwsprites-non-line-guided-grinder
packages.title: Non-Line Guided Grinder
packages.description:
Disassembly of sprite B4, the non-line grounded Grinder, commented on and ready to be inserted with PIXI.

Some stuff such as the X speeds and sound to produce is customisable.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

packages.name: smwsprites-non-line-guided-grinder-kills-sprites
packages.title: Non-Line-Guided Grinder, kills sprites
packages.description:
This is grinder that can kill sprites. Kinda like in SMBX (fan game).
Credit is optional.

packages.name: smwsprites-non-line-guided-mario-following-grinder
packages.title: Non line guided, Mario following Grinder
packages.description:
This is a non-line guided grinder who doesn't dumbly go forward, but chases Mario and tries to kill him.
Based on a dissasembly by Nesquik Bunny.
Please give credit to both me and him.

NOTE: Put a message box, explaining that the sprite follows Mario.
And try not to make 2 of them appear at the same place, since they will "blend" in each other, while going in the same direction.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

Mathos's note: fixed bugs and added a frequency adjusting define (to change how often the sprite retries to face Mario), so give credit too pls

versions.title: Non line guided, Mario following Grinder

packages.name: smwsprites-normal-dkc-rotating-barrels
packages.title: Normal DKC Rotating Barrels
packages.description:
This sprite is the Rotating Barrel from DKC, DKC2 and DKC3. It rotates as soon as the player enters it, then shoots the player in the direction it points.

It is highly customizable: The Extra Bit determines the rotation direction, and there are two Extra Bytes, which control the time the player keeps flying and the barrel rotation's pace. Read the readme for mode details.

packages.name: smwsprites-note-block-bridge-v1
packages.title: Note Block Bridge v1.1
packages.description:
This expanding and contracting bridge is made out of note blocks.
Note that due to the amount of processing time this sprite takes, SA-1 may be needed for a better experience.

v1.1
---
- Removed the vertical variant.
- Fixed Yoshi bounce offset.

packages.name: smwsprites-npcs-v4
packages.title: NPCs v4.4
packages.description:
This is a sprite that doesn't hurt the player and doesn't interact with any other sprites. It can stay still, walk around, or jump, and also display a message if the player presses a button while touching it.

It's compatible with SMW's regular message boxes (can use any message in any level and show up to two at once), the Message Box Expansion patch, and also the VWF Dialogues patch.

The movement, graphics and message behavior are highly customizable. All the options are in the extra bytes (of which it uses all 12). This means you only need to have one entry in your sprite list and can fully customize it as you place it in your level!

All the customization options are explained in HOW_TO_USE.html, so please refer to that. It also has a user-friendly configuration tool.

--------------------

Changelog (see changelog.txt for details):

- 2023-10-22: fixed the calculation of the custom talking frame
- 2023-02-11: fixed some message handling conflicts when touching more than one NPC at a time
- 2022-01-24: added options for 16x16 and 32x32 sprites, improved solid sprite handling, added compatibility with the upcoming version of the VWF Dialogues patch, and added other minor options
- 2022-01-07: fixed some issues people have reported

packages.name: smwsprites-nsmb-propeller-block-v1
packages.title: NSMB Propeller Block v1.1
packages.description:
The Propeller Block seen in the NSMB series, simplified for SMW because the screen is a lot smaller anyway.

While holding it, Mario jumps higher and descends slower, making it useful for vertical levels, secret paths up above or just to add another option to avoid tough obstacles.


Setting the Extra Bit makes the jump enable a much higher jump, that can be used to scale vertical levels a lot better, but is not that great in horizontal levels, as Mario will constantly jump above the screen.

Includes propeller ExGFX that go in SP2 and overwrite half of the Smiley Coin's graphics, but can be adjusted by finding the "TileGFX" label and changing the values.

v1.1: fix infinite upthrow and grab, adds sa-1 compatibility

packages.name: smwsprites-nsmbu-moving-turn-block-bridge
packages.title: NSMBU - Moving Turn Block Bridge
packages.description:
This is a turn block bridge that moves vertically like in NSMBU.

Credit is unecessary. Requested by Roberto Zampari.

packages.name: smwsprites-numbered-limited-use-springboard
packages.title: Numbered Limited Use Springboard
packages.description:
A modification of the Springboard which allows it to be limited to a specific number of bounces and show a number for how many uses are remaining.


Supports 1-9 uses or infinite and number of uses can be set in LM via the extension/extra bytes not requiring multiple inserts.

packages.name: smwsprites-numbered-multi-hit-p-switch
packages.title: Numbered Multi-Hit P-Switch
packages.description:
A modification of the P-Switch which allows it to be used multiple times and show a number for how many uses are remaining.


Supports 1-9 uses or infinite and number of uses can be set in LM via the extension/extra bytes not requiring multiple inserts.

1.1 Update:
Is now inedible while in pressed state
Number takes the layer priority of the switch so it goes behind pipes when taking it through
0 in the number of uses also counts as infinite instead of showing 0 and underflowing

packages.name: smwsprites-nut
packages.title: Nut
packages.description:
The nut from SMB3 airship levels which is rideable.

This sprite was part of Romi's Sprite Package, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

packages.name: smwsprites-on-off-skull-raft
packages.title: ON/OFF Skull Raft
packages.description:
A skull raft which is solid depending on the ON/OFF status: the extra bit controls whether it's solid when the switch is ON (clear) or OFF (set).
The first extension byte controls the number of skulls, but be careful! Each skull is an individual sprite, just like in the vanilla game.

Requested by Metro Shroomin.

packages.name: smwsprites-on-off-toggling-thwomp
packages.title: On/Off Toggling Thwomp
packages.description:
This thwomp will toggle on/off switch when it lands.

Credit is unecessary. Requested by Israelcv12cv.

packages.name: smwsprites-one-ride-platform
packages.title: "One Ride" Platform
packages.description:
A platform on which Mario can ride to the left or right.
Once Mario jumps or steps off the platform, the platform falls off the screen.

Two config files are included:
oneride_plat_r.cfg -- Platform which goes to the right.
oneride_plat_l.cfg -- Platform which goes to the left.

Platform's direction is determined by extra property byte 1 of said cfg files.

In addition, a graphics file for SP4 is included, based off of GFX20.bin. The only difference is two little arrow graphics replacing some unused tiles.

Now PIXI compatible.

packages.name: smwsprites-orange-platforms
packages.title: Orange Platforms
packages.description:
This is a disassembly of sprites 5D and 5E in SMW, the orange floating platforms. The extra bit determines which of the original sprites it acts like. I also included one that acts EXACTLY like the original, meaning that the one that acts like 5D never shows up at all when sprite buoyancy is off. (I just had to add one branch statement to the INIT routine.) (How is that remotely useful ?)

Now SA-1 hybrid.

packages.name: smwsprites-orbinaut-v1-1
packages.title: Orbinaut v1.1.0
packages.description:
Orbinaut sprite from the Sonic series, requested by NopeContest.

The orbinaut is a sphere with four spike balls orbiting around it. The orbinaut can throw the balls in Mario's direction if the player is close enough. It can be customized in several ways via extra bytes and defines (customizations are documented in the ASMs file).

N.B.: This only works with PIXI 1.40 or newer. Older versions of PIXI are not supported.

packages.name: smwsprites-p-balloon
packages.title: P-Balloon
packages.description:
This is a disassembly of sprite 7D, the (P-)Balloon.

Extra bit can make the sprite fly in the other direction.

Speed, sound and behavior options are all available.

packages.name: smwsprites-p-ring
packages.title: P-Ring
packages.description:
(Based on the Blue Ring of NSLU)

Unlike as a p-switch you neend't hit it at the top and you can actived by going (or running) through it, so it's good for levels where you must almost run the whole time.

You needn't give credits.

Now SA-1 hybrid. There were also two .asm files, one depending on extra bit and the other on the X position: only the former has been kept because of practicality.

packages.name: smwsprites-p-switch-and-on-off-blocks-sprite
packages.title: P-Switch And On/Off Blocks Sprite
packages.description:
This sprite can activate Blue/Silver P-switch timer or flip on/off status when hit from below. Disappears in puff of smoke on extra bit.

Credit is optional.

packages.name: smwsprites-panel-monster
packages.title: Panel Monster
packages.description:
This strange monster, from Solomon's Key, fires off projectiles to Mario. The extra bit controls the direction of the monster.

Check the ASM file for some customisation options.

packages.name: smwsprites-panser
packages.title: Panser
packages.description:
The plant-like creature from SMB2 that spits fireballs. It has many available configurations that can be customized through the ASM file, and the palette/behaviors are defined through Extra Byte 1.

This sprite was part of imamelia's Misc. Sprite Pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

packages.name: smwsprites-panser-shower-edition
packages.title: Panser, Shower Edition
packages.description: This Panser functions a differently than the one from SMB2. When it opens its mouth, it sprays an eratic flurry of tiny fireballs into the air. This makes it a difficult enemy to deal with. Extra bit determines if it'll walk or not, and if walking, it'll use a different palette configured through the ASM file.

packages.name: smwsprites-paper-mario-gulpit
packages.title: Paper Mario Gulpit
packages.description:
This is the Gulpit sprite from Paper Mario. It walks until it comes in contact with a rock sprite (included), after which it will gulp it and then spit it at the player.

Credit would be appreciated but isn't required. Note that it uses all of SP4.

Make sure to specify the sprite number of the rock in gulpit.asm! Check the ASM files for configuration options.

Demonstration video: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lb0Lr6J9rJc

packages.name: smwsprites-paper-mario-hammer
packages.title: Paper Mario Hammer
packages.description: This is the hammer from Paper Mario, you can swing it to shake the ground and stun enemies.

packages.name: smwsprites-para-beetle
packages.title: Para-Beetle
packages.description:
This is a flying sprite found in 5-6 in SMB3 as well as a few levels in newer Mario games. Its speed, direction, and size are customizable.
Updates by MarkAlarm: expands the extra byte functionality to allow using all 8 sprite palettes, along with adding a "toxicity" behavior to standing on the para-beetle, which will hurt/kill the player depending on the bits set. Update requested by gohkenytp8. Also includes slightly updated graphics and palette by Anorakun.

packages.name: smwsprites-para-dry-bones
packages.title: Para-Dry Bones
packages.description:
A dry bones with a jump pattern similar to that of a green parakoopa.
The extra bit configures the jumping pattern. The extra property byte 1 sets what dry bones to spawn when stomped on.

packages.name: smwsprites-para-spiny-flies-in-an-ellipse-pattern
packages.title: Para-spiny, Flies in an Ellipse Pattern
packages.description:
A winged Spiny which flies in an elliptic range (can also be circular), controlled by the extra bytes.

Dedicated to Koopster who made the graphics routine (and the original Para-spiny).

versions.title: Para-spiny, Flies in an Ellipse Pattern

packages.name: smwsprites-para-spiny-v1
packages.title: Para-Spiny v1.2
packages.description:
A spiny that flies in a pattern like the red parakoopas. The extra bit will determine the direction.
Requested by allowiscous.

Now the graphics routine makes sense and the horizontal spiny hovers vertically similar to the red parakoopa.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

v1.1 (spooonsss):
Add define to disable up/down movement of the horizontally-moving spiny
Convert .cfg to .json
Optimize asm

Fix bug where horizontally-moving paraspiny moved up-left and down-right, instead making it move only left to right (while oscillating up and down)
Fix bug where the wrong despawn range has been used (originally used the scale platforms).

packages.name: smwsprites-parachute-goomba-parachute-bob-omb
packages.title: Parachute Goomba / Parachute Bob-Omb
packages.description: A disassembly of sprites 3F and 40, the parachute Goomba and parachute Bob-Omb.

packages.name: smwsprites-parachute-spiny
packages.title: Parachute Spiny
packages.description:
This is a spiny that uses a parachute to descend.

Requested by SmashNcrab.

packages.name: smwsprites-parachute-thwomp-v1
packages.title: Parachute Thwomp v1.0
packages.description:
Exactly what it says on the tin. It's a Thwomp with a tiny parachute.

Requested for the Strongest Sprite Workshop 2020 by Sammmoo

packages.name: smwsprites-paragoomba-flies-in-a-range
packages.title: Paragoomba, flies in a range
packages.description: A Goomba which follows a flight pattern similar to that of the red parakoopas. The extra bit determines which.

packages.name: smwsprites-paraspiny
packages.title: Paraspiny
packages.description:
Paraspinies are Spinies that can fly! The only way the player can defeat them is to shoot a Fireball at them, whip them with a Cape, or run into them while being invincible from a Starman.

This sprite was originally part of andy_k_250's Custom Tweaked Sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards. They were made as a demo of the ability for mikeyk's Spritetool (also inherited by PIXI) to create tweaked copies of vanilla sprites without altering the vanilla sprites themselves, via a .cfg file that does not reference an .asm file at all. Therefore, the lack of .asm files in this download is not only intentional, it is the main idea.

packages.name: smwsprites-parental-big-bertha-underwater
packages.title: Parental Big Bertha (Underwater)
packages.description:
This is the Big Bertha from SMB3 which is rarely seen underwater. She will swim back and forth occasionally "spitting" out a baby Cheep Cheep before sucking it back into her mouth.

This sprite is heavily based on SMB3's code, with some minor changes to the timing of the sprite to allow it to spit the baby out more consistently.

This sprite is not required to be in water to function, and will function normally outside of water.

packages.name: smwsprites-pelican-brother
packages.title: Pelican Brother
packages.description:
This difficult enemy paces back and forth slowly, staying on ledges ala the Red Koopa Troopa. When Mario gets in front of it, it jumps up and spits a spiky fish at him (or any other sprite you specify) which bounces along the ground and is harmful to collide with (though you can spin-jump off it). When it lands, it changes direction. It takes three stomps to defeat this enemy, and with each stomp, the Pelican Bro's movement speed becomes faster.

This sprite is customizable in several ways. GFX and a Readme are included (use SP4). This sprite was designed with the Wario Land II enemy in mind, but it behaves a little differently, obviously.

Give credit if used or tweaked.

packages.name: smwsprites-pendulum-ball-n-chain
packages.title: Pendulum Ball N' Chain
packages.description:
This Ball N' Chain edit follows a pendulum trajectory. It was originally part of a pendulum-based sprite pack by Alcaro.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

packages.name: smwsprites-pendulum-rotating-gray-platform
packages.title: Pendulum Rotating Gray Platform
packages.description:
This Rotating Gray Platform edit follows a pendulum trajectory. It was originally part of a pendulum-based sprite pack by Alcaro.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

packages.name: smwsprites-pendulum-roto-disc
packages.title: Pendulum Roto Disc
packages.description:
This Roto Disc edit follows a pendulum trajectory. It was originally part of a pendulum-based sprite pack by Alcaro.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

(Rykon-V73): Added a .json file for the old version of the sprite and added a .json file for the good version of the sprite. There are 2 ExGFX files for the sprite. I do suggest using the good one, since it has the 2 firebar GFX removed. You can go back to the old version though. Read the readme for details.

packages.name: smwsprites-penguin-soldier
packages.title: Penguin Soldier
packages.description:
This little dude is from the game "Magical Pop'n". He walks back and forth until Mario comes within 5 blocks of him, then he chases Mario. If mario gets too close, he slashes mario. Will also slash shells, goombas, etc when thrown at him, unless you throw them at him from behind (Though even then he will deflect them sometimes). Kill him by jumping on him, just like any normal enemy.
Of note: This is a dynamic sprite! That means you must patch dsx.asm to use this sprite (I inlcuded graphics and a palette that it needs)

Extra Bit: No
No credit necessary, have fun.

packages.name: smwsprites-phanto
packages.title: Phanto
packages.description:
This is the Phanto from SMB2.
It will chase the player when they hold a Key, but a custom version will flash and chase the player when they hold a Throw Block.

Additionally, this sprite contains a Generator sprite that can be used to spawn this sprite when the player holds the appropriate item. An UberASM version of the generator is also included.

Part of my SMB2 sprite standardization project; a project aiming to perfectly recreate the original enemies while adding new functionality.

Release History:
- 7/9/2023: V1.0 (C3 2023) - Initial Release.
- 7/16/2023: V1.01 - Fixed a crash when touching the sprite with a star.
- 05/11/2024: V1.02 - Update maded by TheXander, Requested by Samantha:
Added 32X32 Support.
Fixed a crash when Mario collides with the Phanto on sliding state.
Some minor tweaks.

packages.name: smwsprites-pidgit
packages.title: Pidgit
packages.description:
This is the Pidgit from SMB2.
Several custom varieties are included:
- Blue: Same behavior as SMB2; moves back and forth a few times before swooping.
      - Spawns yellow Carpet with average speed.
- Green: Moves back and forth in faster intervals and does a wider swoop.
      - Spawns red Carpet with fast speed.
- Yellow: Follows player and swoops down at a fixed speed.
      - Spawns green Carpet with average speed.
- Red: Quickly follows player and swoops down aiming to hit player, and throws fireballs at the lowest point of the swoop.
      - Spawns blue Carpet with fast speed.

Part of my SMB2 sprite standardization project; a project aiming to perfectly recreate the original enemies while adding new functionality.

Release History:
- 9/1: V1.0 - Initial Release.

packages.name: smwsprites-pile-driver-micro-goomba
packages.title: Pile Driver Micro Goomba
packages.description: This is that jumping block from a few levels in Super Mario Bros. 3.  The sprite was originally made by edit1754, but I updated it to use with PIXI.

packages.name: smwsprites-piledriver-micro-goomba
packages.title: Piledriver Micro-Goomba
packages.description:
This is the Piledriver Micro-Goomba from SMB3 which is seen in some Desert world levels. The sprite has been ported from SMB3's code directly, but with some changes to the code to add more functionality.

The intent is that the "disguised" block will be ExAnimated with Brick Block graphics, however these are not provided. Instead, they will use the Turn Block graphics in SP1.

The 8x8 Goomba is by default tile 7F in SP3, but you can easily change this as needed.

NOTE: The Micro-Goomba's downward velocity can reach x70 when falling, which is known to create issues with SMW's default object collision.
From certain heights, the sprite sprite can clip through the floors that are not entirely solid, such as tile 100.
To better mitigate the chance of this occurring, it is recommended to use this sprite in areas where flat, entirely solid ground is the expected terrain for it to travel on.

I opted not to fix this, as it'd require a lower downward Y speed or multiple instances of the object collision routine would need to be run.
If you want to lower the Y speed, you can do so by changing line 295 (a "CMP #$70").

packages.name: smwsprites-pinkie-the-carriable-triangle
packages.title: Pinkie the Carriable Triangle
packages.description:
This is a normal pink triangle except you can pick it up and move it. Acts like any carriable sprite until you put it on the ground and it becomes a block.
Includes an ExGFX file that replaces the smile coin in SP2 with a triangle.

See readme for details

Some of the code base is from the key disassembly by RussianMan

packages.name: smwsprites-pionpi
packages.title: Pionpi
packages.description:
The jumping jiang shi from Super Mario Land that moves towards the player. It can be stomped, but after some frames, it'll wake up again.

This sprite was part of smkdan's Super Mario Land sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

packages.name: smwsprites-pipe-dwelling-bowser-statue
packages.title: Pipe Dwelling Bowser Statue
packages.description:
This is a bowser statue that acts like a piranha plant. When it's out of the pipe, it'll spit a fireball.
Credit is optional.

packages.name: smwsprites-pipe-dwelling-bullet-bill-blaster
packages.title: Pipe-Dwelling Bullet Bill Blaster
packages.description:
